target: Calidi Biotherapeutics, Inc., a Nevada corporation
consideration_type: Stock, plus a contingent right for Calidi stockholders to receive additional New Calidi common stock if specified share-price thresholds are met.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration to Calidi common stockholders is stated; fractional shares of New Calidi common stock are rounded down to the nearest whole share rather than paid in cash.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each share of Calidi common stock, a variable number of shares of New Calidi common stock equal to the Conversion Ratio: the Per Share Price divided by 10, where the Per Share Price equals Merger Consideration divided by Fully-Diluted Calidi Shares. An estimated 0.40 shares of New Calidi common stock per 1 share of Calidi common stock is disclosed, but the actual ratio will be calculated at closing and may differ. Merger Consideration is based on $250 million, subject to a net-debt adjustment and any pre-closing milestone adjustment. Fractional New Calidi shares are rounded down to the nearest whole share. Former Calidi stockholders may also receive, pro rata, up to 18 million contingent shares in four increments of 4.5 million shares if the specified $12, $14, $16 and $18 trading-price thresholds are met during the five years after closing.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted: approval by FLAG stockholders of the Business Combination, Charter, Incentive Plan, ESPP, New Board and NYSE American proposals, and requisite Calidi stockholder approval; expiration or termination of any applicable antitrust waiting period; receipt of specified third-party consents; no effective law or order prohibiting the transactions; FLAG net tangible assets of at least $5,000,001 after redemptions; satisfaction of the $15 million minimum cash condition after applicable redemptions and unpaid transaction expenses; election or appointment of the post-closing board; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without a stop order; and approval for listing of merger-consideration shares on NYSE American or another agreed exchange. Each party also has conditions concerning the other party’s representations and warranties, material covenant compliance and absence of a continuing, uncured material adverse effect. FLAG’s additional conditions include effective Voting and Lock-Up Agreements, required treatment of Calidi convertible securities, and no more than 5% of Calidi stock being dissenting shares or shares whose holders remain entitled to perfect appraisal rights. Calidi’s additional conditions include an effective Sponsor Agreement, required disposition of Sponsor and Metric incentive securities, and waiver of the IPO underwriter’s deferred compensation and expenses. The filing states that the IPO underwriter waived its deferred fee on December 6, 2022; it does not establish that all closing conditions were satisfied.
event_status: Pending; merger agreement signed January 9, 2023 and amended February 9 and June 16, 2023. The filing describes the business combination as proposed and subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Calidi Biotherapeutics, Inc. common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, outstanding immediately before the merger after conversion of applicable Calidi preferred stock and convertible securities. Treasury or other excluded shares are cancelled without consideration; dissenting shares are subject to separate appraisal-rights treatment. Outstanding Calidi options are assumed and converted into options for New Calidi common stock rather than receiving the common-stock merger consideration.
effective_date: Conditional: the merger becomes effective when the Articles of Merger are filed with the Nevada Secretary of State on the closing date, or at a later time specified in those Articles of Merger. No calendar effective date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Calidi common stockholders receive the stock consideration and contingent right specified by the merger agreement, subject to separate treatment for dissenting and excluded shares.

closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, waiver: CIRCOR stockholder approval by holders of a majority of outstanding common shares; specified foreign regulatory approvals and expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period; and absence of a governmental law, order, injunction or decree prohibiting or making the merger illegal. acquirer: Data Knights Acquisition Corp.; its wholly-owned subsidiary, Data Knights Merger Sub, Inc., will merge with and into the target.
consideration_type: Stock; OneMedNet stockholders are to receive shares of Data Knights Class A common stock. The aggregate merger consideration is subject to working-capital, indebtedness, transaction-expense and post-closing adjustments.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration is stated for OneMedNet stockholders. No fractional shares of Data Knights Class A common stock will be issued; fractional entitlements will be rounded down to the nearest whole share, with no fractional-share cash payment stated.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of OneMedNet common stock, a number of shares of Data Knights common stock equal to the Per Share Consideration divided by the Redemption Price, as set forth on the Allocation Schedule. The Per Share Consideration is the Common Consideration divided by the aggregate number of OneMedNet common shares issued and outstanding immediately before the Effective Time, excluding shares to be cancelled as specified in the agreement. No fixed numerical ratio is stated. Fractional Data Knights Class A common shares will be rounded down to the nearest whole share.
closing_conditions: Unless satisfied or waived where permissible, conditions include approval by Data Knights stockholders of the submitted transaction proposals and the requisite OneMedNet stockholder approval; expiration or termination of applicable antitrust waiting periods; required governmental and specified third-party consents; no law or order preventing the transactions; election or appointment of the post-closing board; SEC effectiveness of the registration statement, its continued effectiveness at closing and no stop order; and Nasdaq approval for listing the merger-consideration shares, subject to official notice of issuance. The merger agreement also specifies at least $5,000,001 in Data Knights net tangible assets after redemptions and any PIPE investment; the proposed NTA amendment would remove the charter limitation. OneMedNet’s obligation to close is additionally subject, unless it waives the applicable conditions, to Data Knights’ representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, absence of an uncured continuing Material Adverse Effect, the Registration Rights Agreement remaining in force, and a $30 million minimum-cash condition. Data Knights’ and Merger Sub’s obligations are additionally subject, unless waived by Data Knights, to OneMedNet’s representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, absence of an uncured continuing Material Adverse Effect, and specified employment, lock-up and non-competition agreements remaining in force. Data Knights’ efforts to obtain PIPE financing are expressly not themselves a closing condition.
event_status: Pending proposed business combination under an executed merger agreement; closing remains subject to approvals and other conditions.
security_description: Issued and outstanding capital stock of OneMedNet Corporation, including Series A-1 and Series A-2 preferred stock, which the agreement requires to convert into OneMedNet common stock immediately before, and contingent upon, the Effective Time. Shares subject to appraisal rights and shares cancelled under the agreement are excepted from the ordinary stockholder exchange. Outstanding options, warrants and convertible promissory notes have separately stated treatment.
effective_date: Not stated as a calendar date. The merger’s Effective Time is the time the Certificate of Merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or a later time specified in that certificate; the form certificate provides for effectiveness upon filing.
available_options: No holder election among cash and stock consideration is stated for OneMedNet stockholders; the stated consideration is Data Knights stock, subject to the agreement’s exceptions.

cash_consideration: No cash consideration is stated for Gryphon shares; fractional shares of Akerna common stock are rounded down to the nearest whole share, not paid in cash.
stock_exchange_ratio: Estimated at approximately 3.51 shares of Akerna common stock per 1 share of Gryphon common stock or preferred stock, assuming a 5-for-1 Akerna reverse stock split and the other stated estimation inputs. The actual per-share portion is determined under the amended Merger Agreement. Aggregate Merger Consideration is the greater of (A) the Akerna fully diluted share number divided by 0.075, minus that fully diluted share number and the adjusted Gryphon warrant share reserve, or (B) $115,625,000 divided by the last reported Nasdaq sale price of Akerna common stock on the second business day before closing. No fractional share is issued; each holder’s resulting shares are rounded down to a whole share.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver of the Merger Agreement’s conditions. Akerna stockholders must approve the merger-related share issuance and change of control, the related sale transaction, reverse stock split, authorized-share increase, name change and 2023 incentive plan; Gryphon stockholders must approve the Merger and adopt the Merger Agreement. Other conditions include no legal restraint preventing or making the Merger or sale transaction illegal; effectiveness of the Form S-4 without an outstanding stop order or related SEC proceeding; material compliance by Akerna and Gryphon with their covenants; satisfaction or waiver of the sale transaction’s closing conditions so it can close immediately after the Merger; and Nasdaq approval of continued listing, including the merger shares. Gryphon’s additional closing conditions include the required accuracy of Akerna’s representations and warranties, no Akerna material adverse effect, compliance with support agreements and the sale and note-exchange agreements, continued Nasdaq listing through the effective time, completion of specified preferred-stock redemptions and the reverse stock split, winding down Akerna’s legacy business, release of note-related encumbrances, at least $500,000 of Akerna cash on hand, satisfaction of conditions for the post-closing exchanges of Akerna notes and Series C preferred stock, and SEC effectiveness of the specified MJ Bridge Co. registration statement. Akerna’s additional conditions include the required accuracy of Gryphon’s representations and warranties, no Gryphon material adverse effect and compliance with Gryphon stockholder support agreements.
event_status: Pending; Merger Agreement entered into on January 27, 2023 and amended on April 28 and June 14, 2023. Completion remains subject to closing conditions.

effective_date: Not specified. The parties anticipated consummation in Akerna’s third fiscal quarter of 2023 but stated that they could not predict when or whether closing would occur.
available_options: No holder election; each outstanding Gryphon common or preferred share is converted into the right to receive its applicable per-share portion of Akerna common stock.

consideration_type: Elective consideration: holders of eligible Triton common shares may choose mixed cash and BIPC shares, all cash, or all BIPC shares. All-cash and all-stock elections are subject to proration if oversubscribed; the value of each option is subject to the BIPC share-price collar.
cash_consideration: Mixed election: US$68.50 per Triton common share, plus BIPC shares. All-cash election: cash per Triton common share equal to the aggregate consideration per share, calculated as total cash consideration plus the value of total BIPC share consideration, divided by the number of common shares outstanding immediately before the merger; subject to proration if cash is oversubscribed. All-stock election: no regular cash consideration, subject to proration that may result in some shares receiving cash. consideration_type: No new merger consideration is payable for Triton preference shares. Each outstanding preference share continues as a preference share of the surviving company with the same rights.
cash_consideration: No cash merger consideration is delivered for each Triton preference share; the shares remain outstanding. A dissenting preference shareholder may receive a cash difference if the court-appraised fair value exceeds the value of the surviving-company preference share.
stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration or exchange ratio applies: each outstanding Triton preference share remains outstanding as a preference share of the surviving company.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled Triton shareholder special general meeting: 8/24/2023 at 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time, in virtual format. Holders of preference and common shares will vote together on the merger proposal. No vote of BIPC shareholders is required.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where legally permitted: the requisite Triton shareholder vote; expiration or termination of applicable HSR Act and any applicable contractual waiting periods; CFIUS clearance and other required regulatory approvals; no effective law or order preventing the transaction; effectiveness of the Form F-3 and Form F-4 registration statements without an SEC stop order; NYSE listing authorization and conditional TSX listing approval for the BIPC shares issued to common shareholders; required accuracy of the parties’ representations and warranties and material performance of their obligations; no Company Material Adverse Effect; and, for Parent’s closing obligation, no regulatory approval imposing a Parent Burdensome Condition. The filing states that the HSR waiting period expired on 6/9/2023 and approvals from the European Union, China and South Korea had been received; the Swiss filing had been made. Receipt of financing and maintenance of the US$750 million target liquidity are expressly not closing conditions.
event_status: Pending as described in the 7/6/2023 proxy statement/joint prospectus: the merger agreement was signed on 4/11/2023, but the shareholder meeting and closing were still prospective.
security_description: Triton International Limited cumulative redeemable perpetual preference shares, par value US$0.01 per share: 8.50% Series A, 8.00% Series B, 7.375% Series C, 6.875% Series D and 5.75% Series E. Each series has the same stated merger treatment.
effective_date: Not specified. The merger will become legally effective when the Registrar of Companies in Bermuda issues the certificate of merger, at the time and date shown on that certificate. The filing states that Brookfield and Triton expected closing during the third quarter of 2023, but could not accurately estimate the closing date.
available_options: No holder election among merger consideration options is stated for preference shares. They remain outstanding with the same rights, and no consideration is delivered. A preference shareholder who does not vote in favor of the merger and meets the stated legal requirements may seek a court appraisal.
default_option: No election is required or provided for preference shares; they remain outstanding as obligations of the surviving company with the same rights, and no merger consideration is delivered.

acquirer: Concentrix Corporation, through its direct wholly owned subsidiary OSYRIS S.à r.l. as purchaser
consideration_type: Cash, a two-year interest-bearing Sellers’ Note, Concentrix common stock, and a contingent right to additional Concentrix common stock if specified conditions are met
cash_consideration: No cash amount per Marnix Lux SA share is stated. The aggregate Closing Cash Payment for the Acquired Shares is €500.0 million, subject to adjustments under the Share Purchase and Contribution Agreement. Sellers receiving Acquired Share consideration also receive a Sellers’ Note with aggregate principal of €700.0 million, a two-year term and 2% annual interest. Cash paid instead of a fractional Concentrix share equals the fraction multiplied by the specified 10-day volume-weighted average price, rounded down to the nearest cent.
shareholder_vote_date: Concentrix stockholders’ special meeting scheduled for 8/4/2023 at 10:00 a.m., Eastern Time, to vote on the share issuance connected with the transaction.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where legally permissible: Concentrix stockholder approval of the share issuance; HSR Act clearance and other required regulatory filings and approvals; no effective law, order, injunction or decree preventing, making illegal or prohibiting the transaction; and authorization for Nasdaq listing of the Concentrix shares issued as consideration. The required works-council consultations were completed in late April 2023, and the HSR Act waiting period expired on 5/15/2023. Additional conditions include specified accuracy standards for the parties’ representations and warranties, material compliance with material covenants, and no specified material adverse effect since the put-option date. Concentrix and Purchaser also require delivery of specified closing certificates and an updated Webhelp Parent shareholder register, the transferred shares plus specified treasury and locked incentive shares representing at least 99.5% of Webhelp Parent’s fully diluted share capital and rights, and approval of an amendment to Webhelp Parent’s articles of association. Obtaining financing is not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending as of the 7/6/2023 proxy statement; the put option was exercised on 6/2/2023 and the Share Purchase and Contribution Agreement was executed on 6/12/2023.
security_description: Issued and outstanding shares of capital stock of Marnix Lux SA held by the Sellers, categorized under the agreement as Acquired Shares, Contributed Shares and Exchanged Shares. Locked Equity Incentive Shares and Treasury Shares are distinguished from those transferred shares.
effective_date: Conditionally, 9:00 a.m., Eastern Time, on the closing date; no calendar closing date is stated.
available_options: No holder election. Under the agreement, Acquired Shares are sold for the cash payment and Sellers’ Note; Contributed Shares are contributed for Closing Shares of Concentrix common stock; and Exchanged Shares are transferred for the contingent right to Earnout Shares.

consideration_type: Stock, with a contingent right for eligible Allurion equityholders to receive additional shares if specified share-price thresholds are met during the earnout period or upon a qualifying change of control.
cash_consideration: No cash is paid for fractional shares eliminated by rounding; no regular per-share cash merger consideration is stated.
stock_exchange_ratio: Each eligible Allurion common share converts into New Allurion common stock at the Intermediate Merger Exchange Ratio: (37,812,000 minus Allocated Shares) divided by Fully Diluted Company Capitalization. The filing expects 1.0355 New Allurion common shares per 1 Allurion common share under its stated no-redemptions assumptions; the stated maximum-redemptions pro forma scenario uses 0.9944. Each eligible preferred share receives the number of Allurion common shares into which it would convert immediately before the merger, multiplied by the Intermediate Merger Exchange Ratio. Each holder’s aggregate New Allurion shares are rounded down to a whole share. The no- and maximum-redemptions figures are scenario assumptions, not a fixed ratio.
shareholder_vote_date: Compute Health stockholders’ Special Meeting scheduled for 7/28/2023 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time. Allurion stockholder approval is to be obtained by written consent within 48 hours after the registration statement becomes effective; no consent date is stated.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver of the applicable conditions: requisite Compute Health stockholder approval, including a separate Class A vote, and requisite Allurion stockholder approval; effectiveness of the registration statement without an effective stop order or pending SEC proceeding seeking one; NYSE listing approval for the New Allurion common stock and applicable listing requirements; absence of orders, laws or other legal restraints preventing the Business Combination; applicable HSR Act waiting-period expiration or termination, although counsel determined no HSR filing was required; at least $5,000,001 of Compute Health net tangible assets immediately before the CPUH Merger becomes effective; at least $70 million of Net Closing Cash, subject to the stated expense-related limits on which party may assert that condition; and consummation of the Fortress and Revenue Interest financings. Party-specific conditions include the applicable representations and warranties, material covenant compliance and absence of the applicable material adverse effect; approvals by the sole stockholder or member of the merger entities; and, for Compute Health, a satisfactory Runway Loan payoff letter and related lien releases.
event_status: Pending; Business Combination Agreement dated 2/9/2023 and amended on 5/2/2023. Stockholder approval and closing remained conditional as described in the proxy statement/prospectus.
security_description: Allurion Technologies, Inc. common stock and its Series A, Series A-1, Series B, Series C, Series D-1, Series D-2 and Series D-3 preferred stock, each with $0.0001 par value per share. This record concerns outstanding eligible shares, including common shares issued upon conversion of Allurion convertible notes; dissenting and canceled treasury or subsidiary-held shares are excluded. Options, RSU awards and warrants have separate rollover treatment.
effective_date: Proposed to become effective when the Intermediate Merger certificate is accepted for filing by the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later date or time agreed in writing by Compute Health and Allurion and specified in that certificate. The filing states that the Intermediate Merger takes effect at least three hours after the CPUH Merger becomes effective. The parties expected the Business Combination to become effective during the third quarter of 2023; no exact effective date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election for the merger consideration is described for eligible Allurion shares; common and preferred shares are converted under their respective stated formulas. Dissenting shares are treated separately under the appraisal provisions.
default_option: Eligible outstanding Allurion common and preferred shares convert into the right to receive New Allurion common stock under their respective formulas, subject to the stated exclusions and rounding.

consideration_type: Stock and Merger Consideration Warrants. Each outstanding Jet Token common share, including preferred shares converted into common shares immediately before the First Merger, is to receive Jet.AI common stock and warrants to acquire Jet.AI common stock, each based on its applicable exchange ratio and adjusted for Net Indebtedness.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration in the Business Combination. No cash settlement is to be made for fractional shares eliminated by rounding.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 outstanding share of Jet Token Common Stock, including a share resulting from conversion of Jet Token Preferred Stock immediately before the First Merger: Jet.AI Common Stock equal to the Stock Exchange Ratio, rounded to six decimal places, calculated as (($45,000,000 − (Net Indebtedness as of the Closing Date × 0.428571)) ÷ $10.00) ÷ Jet Token Outstanding Shares. acquirer: TradeUP Acquisition Corp. (UPTD), through its wholly-owned merger subsidiary Tradeup Merger Sub Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; Estrella stockholders will receive newly issued TradeUP Acquisition Corp. common stock.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration to Estrella stockholders is specified; the merger consideration is payable in newly issued shares of TradeUP Acquisition Corp. common stock.
stock_exchange_ratio: Each share of Estrella Biopharma, Inc. common stock outstanding immediately before the effective time, including shares resulting from conversion of Estrella preferred stock, converts into a right to receive shares of TradeUP Acquisition Corp. common stock equal to the per-share merger consideration value divided by $10.00. The per-share merger consideration value equals the $325,000,000 equity value, subject to adjustment pursuant to a subsequent written agreement between TradeUP Acquisition Corp. and Estrella, divided by the total number of Estrella common shares outstanding immediately before the effective time, including shares issued upon preferred-stock conversion and fully vested restricted shares. Fractional shares that would otherwise be issued are rounded to the nearest whole share, subject to an alternative rounding methodology agreed by the parties so that aggregate issuance equals the merger consideration shares.
closing_conditions: The conditions are subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted. They include approval by TradeUP Acquisition Corp. stockholders; completion of the redemption offer; expiration or termination of any applicable Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period; absence of a governmental order, statute, rule or regulation enjoining or prohibiting the transaction; at least $5,000,001 of net tangible assets upon consummation; Nasdaq listing approval for the merger consideration shares, subject only to official notice of issuance; at least $20,000,000 in available combined cash; and completion at or before closing of at least $20,000,000 in transaction financing, comprising at least $15,000,000 of equity financing and no more than $5,000,000 of debt or equity-linked financing, on terms acceptable to Estrella. Additional party-specific conditions include the accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, delivery of officer certificates and financing certificates, delivery of specified stockholder lock-up agreements and executive employment agreements, and adoption of the proposed charter. The parties state that they intend to waive the $20,000,000 merger-financing condition if it is not secured or fully secured, provided other conditions, including the net tangible assets requirement, are met.
event_status: Pending as of the filing: the merger agreement was executed on September 30, 2022, and consummation remains subject to conditions. The filing is Amendment No. 6 to Form S-4.
security_description: Estrella Biopharma, Inc. common stock, par value $0.0001 per share. Outstanding Estrella Series A and Series AA preferred stock automatically converts into Estrella common stock immediately before the effective time; those resulting common shares receive merger consideration. Dissenting shares are excluded from the stock conversion and instead carry appraisal rights. Unvested Estrella restricted common shares become vested immediately before the preferred-stock conversion and receive the per-share merger consideration.
effective_date: At the time on the closing date when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed in writing by TradeUP Acquisition Corp. and Estrella Biopharma, Inc. and specified in the certificate of merger. No calendar date or clock time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; the merger agreement specifies stock consideration for Estrella common shares, subject to separate statutory appraisal treatment for qualifying dissenting shares.

acquirer: Coherus BioSciences, Inc. (parent); Crimson Merger Sub I, Inc. and Crimson Merger Sub II, LLC are its direct, wholly owned merger subsidiaries.
consideration_type: Coherus common stock plus one contingent value right (CVR) per eligible share of Surface common stock. The CVR represents a right to conditional payments, if any, that Coherus may make in cash, additional Coherus common stock, or both at its sole discretion. Cash may also be paid instead of fractional shares.
cash_consideration: No fixed cash price per Surface common share is stated. Cash is payable instead of any fractional Coherus share: the fractional share multiplied by $5.2831, rounded to the nearest whole cent, without interest and subject to required tax withholding. Each CVR may result in conditional payments, if any; Coherus may pay those amounts in cash, additional Coherus common stock, or both, at its sole discretion, subject to the CVR Agreement’s deductions, payment threshold, cash and stock limitations, and required approvals.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each eligible share of Surface Oncology, Inc. common stock, a number of shares of Coherus BioSciences, Inc. common stock equal to the Exchange Ratio: (($40,000,000 plus Surface Net Cash) divided by $5.2831) divided by the number of Surface common shares outstanding immediately before the First Merger’s effective time on a fully diluted and as-converted basis as determined under the Merger Agreement. The ratio is rounded down to four decimal places, depends on Surface Net Cash, and is not adjusted for changes in either company’s stock price. No fractional Coherus shares will be issued; cash is paid instead. One CVR is also issued per eligible Surface common share.
closing_conditions: The parties’ obligations to complete the Mergers are subject to Surface stockholder approval of the Merger Agreement; absence of a court order, other legal restraint, or law prohibiting or making the transactions illegal; approval for Nasdaq listing of the Coherus shares to be issued, subject to official notice of issuance; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an outstanding stop order; and execution and continued effectiveness of the CVR Agreement. Each side’s obligation is also subject to specified accuracy standards for the other side’s representations and warranties, material performance of its obligations, absence of a material adverse effect on that side, and receipt of a confirming officer’s certificate. Coherus and the merger subsidiaries additionally require Surface Net Cash of at least $19,600,000, unless Coherus consents in writing to a lower amount. Conditions may be waived where permitted.
event_status: Pending as described in the preliminary Form S-4 filed July 7, 2023; the Merger Agreement was executed June 15, 2023, and completion remained subject to stockholder approval and other closing conditions.
security_description: Surface Oncology, Inc. common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the First Merger’s effective time, excluding shares held in treasury or directly or indirectly by Coherus or its merger subsidiaries and shares for which appraisal rights are properly demanded. Surface stock options and restricted stock units have separately described treatment.
effective_date: Not specified. The First Merger will take effect when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed in writing and specified in that certificate. The Second Merger will take effect promptly afterward when its separate certificate is filed, or at a later time agreed in writing and specified in that certificate. The Mergers were expected to be completed in the third quarter of 2023, but completion was not assured.
available_options: No holder election

security_description: Limeade, Inc. common stock, no par value per share, including shares underlying Limeade CHESS depositary interests (CDIs); each CDI represents a beneficial interest in one common share. effective_date: Legal effective time is conditional: when the articles of merger are properly filed with and accepted by the Washington Secretary of State, or a later time agreed in writing by WebMD and Limeade and specified in those articles. Limeade anticipated completing the merger in the third quarter of 2023; no specific legal effective date or time is stated.

acquirer: TLG Acquisition One Corp. (TLG), through its wholly-owned merger subsidiary Eagle Merger Corp.
consideration_type: Stock; Electriq common stock is exchanged for TLG Class A common stock. Electriq pre-2023 preferred stock and SAFEs convert into Electriq common stock before the merger.
cash_consideration: No regular cash merger consideration is stated for Electriq common stock. No fractional shares of TLG Class A common stock will be issued; fractional entitlements of at least 0.50 share are rounded up to one share, and those below 0.50 share are rounded down to zero. No cash payment in lieu of fractional shares is stated.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of Electriq common stock outstanding immediately before closing, including shares resulting from conversion of Electriq pre-2023 preferred stock and SAFEs: 1 multiplied by the Exchange Ratio shares of TLG Class A common stock. The Exchange Ratio is the merger consideration divided by Total Company Shares Outstanding. Merger consideration consists of 27,500,000 TLG common shares plus additional shares equal to Electriq equity raised in the Private Capital Raise, whether in cash or through conversion of indebtedness, divided by $8.00; the filing describes 3,528,750 additional shares. No fractional TLG Class A shares will be issued: an aggregate fractional entitlement of at least 0.50 is rounded up to one share, and one below 0.50 is rounded down to zero. Excluded and dissenting shares have separate treatment.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver, where permitted, at or before closing: expiration or termination of applicable HSR Act waiting periods (the filing states that this waiting period expired on 1/11/2023); absence of a governmental restraint prohibiting the transaction; Electriq stockholder approval; TLG stockholder approval of the Business Combination, Charter, NYSE and Equity Incentive Plan proposals; NYSE approval for continued listing of Class A common stock, subject only to official notice of issuance and sufficient round-lot holders; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without a pending SEC stop order or related proceeding; and at least $5,000,001 of TLG net tangible assets at closing. TLG's obligation is also conditioned on specified Electriq representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, a good-standing certificate, no Electriq Material Adverse Effect since 6/30/2022, at least $4,500,000 of pre-closing equity-sale net cash proceeds from third parties identified by Electriq, at least $1,500,000 of additional such proceeds upon closing, and conversion of $10,130,000 of Shareholder Notes into Electriq equity. Electriq's obligation is also conditioned on specified TLG and Merger Sub representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, their good-standing certificates, at least $7,500,000 of pre-closing equity-sale net cash proceeds described as Lawrie Pre-Closing Funding, at least $5,000,000 of additional equity-sale net cash proceeds from John Michael Lawrie upon closing, and conversion of $10,130,000 of Shareholder Notes into Electriq equity.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was amended on 12/23/2022, 3/22/2023 and 6/8/2023. The 7/10/2023 filing is a preliminary joint proxy statement/consent solicitation statement/prospectus, and completion remains conditional.
security_description: Electriq common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, including Electriq common shares resulting from the pre-merger conversion of Electriq pre-2023 preferred stock and SAFEs; excludes treasury shares, shares owned by TLG and dissenting shares.
effective_date: Conditional: the merger becomes effective when the certificate of merger is filed with and accepted by the Delaware Secretary of State, or at another time agreed by TLG and Electriq and specified in that certificate. No calendar effective date is stated.
available_options: No holder election under the amended merger agreement for Electriq common stock; holders receive the specified stock consideration, subject to the separate treatment of excluded and dissenting shares.

acquirer: TLG Acquisition One Corp. (TLG), through its wholly-owned merger subsidiary Eagle Merger Corp.
consideration_type: Stock; Electriq Series B Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock is exchanged for TLG Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock. The TLG preferred stock has a 15% cumulative dividend payable in kind and is subject to mandatory redemption on the third anniversary of its original issue date, at the holder's option for cash or TLG common stock.
cash_consideration: No regular cash payment is stated for the exchange of each Electriq cumulative preferred share in the merger. For the TLG preferred stock received, mandatory redemption on the third anniversary of the original issue date is at the holder's option for either $10.00 in cash per TLG preferred share or TLG common stock; this is a later redemption right, not cash paid in the merger.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of Electriq Series B Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock outstanding immediately before closing: 1 multiplied by the Exchange Ratio shares of TLG Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock. The Exchange Ratio is the merger consideration divided by Total Company Shares Outstanding. The filing states that holders of Electriq cumulative preferred stock will receive 1,411,500 TLG preferred shares in aggregate. TLG common shares issued in the later mandatory redemption, if elected, equal $10.00 per TLG preferred share divided by the fair market value of a TLG common share, subject to a maximum of 10 TLG common shares per TLG preferred share; that later redemption ratio is not the merger exchange ratio.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver, where permitted, at or before closing: expiration or termination of applicable HSR Act waiting periods (the filing states that this waiting period expired on 1/11/2023); absence of a governmental restraint prohibiting the transaction; Electriq stockholder approval; TLG stockholder approval of the Business Combination, Charter, NYSE and Equity Incentive Plan proposals; NYSE approval for continued listing of Class A common stock, subject only to official notice of issuance and sufficient round-lot holders; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without a pending SEC stop order or related proceeding; and at least $5,000,001 of TLG net tangible assets at closing. TLG's obligation is also conditioned on specified Electriq representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, a good-standing certificate, no Electriq Material Adverse Effect since 6/30/2022, at least $4,500,000 of pre-closing equity-sale net cash proceeds from third parties identified by Electriq, at least $1,500,000 of additional such proceeds upon closing, and conversion of $10,130,000 of Shareholder Notes into Electriq equity. Electriq's obligation is also conditioned on specified TLG and Merger Sub representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, their good-standing certificates, at least $7,500,000 of pre-closing equity-sale net cash proceeds described as Lawrie Pre-Closing Funding, at least $5,000,000 of additional equity-sale net cash proceeds from John Michael Lawrie upon closing, and conversion of $10,130,000 of Shareholder Notes into Electriq equity.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was amended on 12/23/2022, 3/22/2023 and 6/8/2023. The 7/10/2023 filing is a preliminary joint proxy statement/consent solicitation statement/prospectus, and completion remains conditional.
security_description: Electriq Power, Inc. Series B Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock, par value $0.0001 per share, also described as Electriq cumulative preferred stock. This is distinct from Electriq pre-2023 preferred stock, which converts into Electriq common stock before the merger.
effective_date: Conditional: the merger becomes effective when the certificate of merger is filed with and accepted by the Delaware Secretary of State, or at another time agreed by TLG and Electriq and specified in that certificate. No calendar effective date is stated.
available_options: No holder election between forms of consideration in the merger: Electriq cumulative preferred stock is exchanged for TLG preferred stock. After issuance, the holder may elect cash or TLG common stock upon the TLG preferred stock's mandatory redemption on the third anniversary of its original issue date.

The business combination also requires OTEC net tangible assets of at least $5,000,001 after redemptions.

acquirer: Urgent.ly Inc. (parent); U.O Odyssey Merger Sub Ltd. is its direct wholly owned subsidiary formed to carry out the merger.
consideration_type: Stock; eligible holders of Otonomo ordinary shares receive Urgently common stock, subject to applicable tax withholding. Excluded shares and shares canceled under the Merger Agreement receive no merger consideration.
cash_consideration: No cash merger consideration for Otonomo ordinary shares. Fractional Urgently shares are rounded to the nearest whole share, rather than paid in cash.
stock_exchange_ratio: A variable number of shares of Urgent.ly Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, per 1 Otonomo Technologies Ltd. ordinary share, no par value, equal to the Exchange Ratio. The Exchange Ratio equals Otonomo Merger Shares divided by the fully diluted Otonomo Share Number. Otonomo Merger Shares equal Post-Closing Company Shares multiplied by the Otonomo Allocation Percentage; Post-Closing Company Shares equal the fully diluted Company Share Number divided by the Company Allocation Percentage. Each allocation percentage reflects that company's valuation divided by the aggregate valuation. Otonomo's valuation equals its net cash; Urgently's valuation equals $271.0 million plus its net cash. The net-cash calculations include specified cash, indebtedness, transaction-expense, tax and, for Otonomo, excess cash-burn adjustments. The ratio was estimated at 1.42 based on assumptions as of March 31, 2023, but is subject to final determination before closing. Fractional shares are rounded to the nearest whole share, with 0.5 rounded up. The stated 1.42 estimate does not give effect to the expected, shareholder-approval-dependent reverse splits.
shareholder_vote_date: Otonomo Technologies Ltd. shareholders: special general meeting scheduled for an unspecified date in 2023 at 4:00 p.m., Israel time. Urgent.ly Inc. stockholders approved the proposed charter and bylaws on 2/10/2023; the filing does not state a date for their merger-related stockholder consent.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted: Otonomo shareholder approval, Merger Sub shareholder approval and Urgently stockholder consent; no applicable law or governmental order prohibiting or restraining the transaction and no pending governmental action challenging or seeking to enjoin it; SEC effectiveness of the registration statement without a stop order; Nasdaq approval for listing the Urgently common stock and assumed warrants, subject to official notice of issuance; necessary foreign-investment consents, filings or approvals and UK National Security and Investment Act clearance; Israeli statutory merger requirements, including at least 50 days after filing the merger proposal and at least 30 days after shareholder approvals; the Israeli Securities Authority no-action letter; specified Israeli 104H, withholding and 102 tax rulings; and final determination of the Exchange Ratio. Each party's additional conditions include the other party's specified representations and warranties being accurate at the applicable standard, material compliance with covenants, no continuing uncured material adverse effect, and required officer certificates. Urgently and Merger Sub additionally require Otonomo director and officer resignation letters; Otonomo additionally requires compliance with the board-appointment provision. UK NSIA approval was received on 4/18/2023, and the ISA no-action letter was obtained on 6/13/2023. Approval of the CEO and CFO retention-bonus proposals is not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending as described in the preliminary proxy statement/prospectus dated 7/10/2023; the merger agreement was executed on 2/9/2023, and closing was expected in the third quarter of 2023, subject to approvals and other closing conditions.
security_description: Issued and outstanding ordinary shares, no par value, of Otonomo Technologies Ltd., other than excluded shares and shares canceled under the Merger Agreement. Otonomo warrants and equity awards have separately described treatment.
effective_date: No calendar date specified. The merger legally becomes effective when the Israeli Registrar of Companies issues the certificate of merger under Section 323(5) of the Israeli Companies Law. The parties intend issuance and legal effectiveness to occur on the Closing Date; closing is expected in the third quarter of 2023, subject to conditions.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Otonomo ordinary shares are exchanged for Urgently common stock under the Merger Agreement.

acquirer: AltC Acquisition Corp.; its direct, wholly owned subsidiary AltC Merger Sub, Inc. will merge into Oklo Inc.
consideration_type: Stock: AltC Class A common stock at closing, plus a contingent right for eligible holders to receive additional AltC Class A common stock if specified price targets are met during the earnout period.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration to Oklo shareholders.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of Oklo Inc. common stock outstanding immediately before the effective time, after conversion of Oklo preferred stock and SAFEs, the holder receives shares of AltC Acquisition Corp. Class A common stock equal to the Exchange Ratio. The Exchange Ratio is the Per Share Equity Value, divided by $10.00 and rounded to the nearest 0.001; Per Share Equity Value is the sum of the Equity Value and the aggregate exercise price of all outstanding Oklo options, divided by Company Total Shares and rounded to the nearest $0.01. Equity Value is $850,000,000 plus net proceeds from any permitted pre-closing equity financing. Company Total Shares includes outstanding Oklo stock after the conversions and shares issuable upon exercise of all Oklo options immediately before the effective time, including applicable acceleration. No fractional AltC shares will be issued; each holder's aggregate entitlement is rounded to the nearest whole share, with 0.5 or more rounded up. Eligible holders also have a pro rata contingent right to up to 15,000,000 additional AltC Class A shares: 7,500,000 at the $12.00 trigger, 5,000,000 at the $14.00 trigger and 2,500,000 at the $16.00 trigger. Each trigger is based on the closing stock price for 20 trading days within a 60-consecutive-trading-day period during the earnout period, or qualifying change-in-control consideration; the share amounts and price targets are subject to the agreement's equitable-adjustment provisions.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted written waiver of applicable conditions: expiration or termination of the HSR Act waiting period; no governmental order, statute, rule or regulation enjoining or prohibiting the transactions; AltC having at least $5,000,001 in net tangible assets after shareholder redemptions; approval of the AltC stockholder matters and Oklo stockholder approval; required governance arrangements and post-closing board appointments; listing and continued-listing eligibility of the contemplated AltC shares, including earnout shares; and effectiveness of the registration statement without an SEC stop order or threatened or initiated action seeking one. Additional conditions to AltC's obligations include specified accuracy of Oklo's representations and warranties, material compliance with its covenants, no continuing Oklo Material Adverse Effect, delivery of an officer's certificate, and no NRC communication reasonably expected to materially adversely affect Oklo's ability to secure a Combined Construction and Operating License for the subject reactor. Additional conditions to Oklo's obligations include specified accuracy of AltC parties' representations and warranties, material compliance with their covenants, no continuing AltC Material Adverse Effect, Available Closing SPAC Cash of at least $250,000,000, delivery of an officer's certificate, and material performance of Sponsor Agreement covenants without specified threats concerning that agreement.
event_status: Announced; merger agreement signed and proposed transaction pending closing.
security_description: Oklo Inc. common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, including common shares issued upon the required pre-closing conversion of Oklo preferred stock and Simple Agreements for Future Equity. Excluded shares are cancelled without consideration; dissenting shares are subject to appraisal treatment. Oklo options are assumed and treated separately.
effective_date: Proposed merger: the effective time will be when the Certificate of Merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State on the closing date, or a later time agreed in writing by Oklo and AltC and specified in the filing. No calendar date is stated. Closing was expected in late 2023 or early 2024.
available_options: No holder election; eligible shares are exchanged for the specified stock consideration, subject to excluded-share and dissenting-share treatment.

acquirer: Murphy Canyon Acquisition Corp. (MURF), through its wholly owned merger subsidiary, Conduit Merger Sub, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; Conduit shareholders receive New Conduit common stock, subject to the treatment of dissenting shares.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration is stated for Conduit ordinary shares; holders receive New Conduit common stock, subject to the treatment of dissenting shares.
stock_exchange_ratio: Each Conduit ordinary share, including shares issued upon conversion of Conduit convertible debt, converts into its holder's pro rata portion of an aggregate 65,000,000 shares of New Conduit common stock. The amended Exchange Ratio is the quotient of $650,000,000 divided by the number of Conduit capital shares, divided by $10.00. The ratio is subject to adjustment for specified changes in outstanding securities; fractional shares are rounded down to the nearest whole share.
closing_conditions: Conditions include approval of the transaction proposals by MURF stockholders and approval by Conduit shareholders; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without a stop order or related SEC proceeding; absence of legal restraints and specified governmental litigation; completion and clearance of required HSR filings and waiting periods; Nasdaq listing approval for the shares to be issued; execution of ancillary agreements and specified lock-up agreements; at least $27 million in required available cash or proceeds after applicable redemptions, subject to the agreement's stated cash tests; and MURF having at least $5,000,001 in net tangible assets or otherwise being exempt from Securities Act Rule 419. Additional party-specific conditions include accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, absence of a continuing material adverse effect, required certificates and consents, conversion or cancellation of Conduit convertible securities, transfer of Conduit UK Management Ltd. and assignment of specified intellectual property, and an equity incentive plan. Conditions may be waived where permissible, but the stated net-tangible-assets-or-Rule-419 condition may not be waived.
event_status: Pending; the November 8, 2022 merger agreement was amended on January 27, 2023 and May 11, 2023. Completion remains subject to approvals and other closing conditions.
security_description: Conduit Pharmaceuticals Limited ordinary shares, par value GBP0.0001 per share, including ordinary shares issued upon conversion of specified Conduit convertible debt; dissenting shares receive separate treatment.
effective_date: Not specified. Subject to satisfaction or waiver of closing conditions, the merger becomes effective when the plan of merger is filed with and accepted by the Registrar of Companies of the Cayman Islands, or at a later date and time agreed by the parties in writing and specified in that plan.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Conduit ordinary shares convert into the right to receive stock consideration, subject to the separate treatment of dissenting shares.

acquirer: Regency Centers Corporation; its wholly owned subsidiary, Hercules Merger Sub, LLC, survives the second merger.
consideration_type: Stock; holders receive Regency Centers Corporation common stock. Cash is payable only in lieu of fractional shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per share is stated. Cash, without interest, is payable only in lieu of a fractional Regency common share, equal to the fractional share multiplied by the volume-weighted average closing price of Regency common stock on the 10 consecutive trading days ending on the second business day before the closing date.
stock_exchange_ratio: 0.347 shares of Regency Centers Corporation common stock per 1 share of Urstadt Biddle Properties Inc. Class A common stock, through the intermediate conversion into 1 share of UB Maryland I, Inc. Class A common stock. The ratio is fixed except for specified adjustments, including REIT dividends and certain changes in outstanding shares. No fractional Regency common shares will be issued.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled Urstadt Biddle Properties Inc. stockholder special meeting: 8/16/2023 at 2:00 p.m., Eastern Time. No Regency Centers Corporation stockholder vote is required.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted, waiver of conditions: approval by Urstadt Biddle common and Class A common stockholders voting together as one class, representing a majority of all votes entitled to be cast; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective stop order or pending SEC stop-order proceeding; no legal restraint or law making the mergers illegal; Nasdaq listing approval for the Regency common and preferred shares to be issued; filing and acceptance of the articles classifying Regency Series A and Series B preferred stock; specified accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, and absence of a material adverse effect; officer certificates; and specified REIT-qualification and Section 368(a) reorganization tax opinions. Debt financing is not a closing condition.
event_status: Announced and pending as described in the proxy statement/prospectus dated 7/12/2023; the mergers remained subject to closing conditions.

available_options: No holder election; the merger agreement specifies stock consideration, with cash only in lieu of fractional shares.

closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, written waiver by the party benefiting from the condition: OmniLit and Syntec Optics stockholder approvals; effectiveness of the registration statement without an SEC stop order or unresolved proceedings to suspend effectiveness; expiration or termination of applicable HSR Act waiting periods; absence of a governmental restraint prohibiting the merger; OmniLit having at least $5,000,001 of net tangible assets immediately before or upon consummation; and Nasdaq approval of the post-merger Class A shares for listing, together with compliance with applicable continuing listing requirements and no uncured notice of non-compliance. acquirer: Diffusion Pharmaceuticals Inc. (parent); its wholly owned subsidiary, Dawn Merger Sub Inc., will merge with and into EIP Pharma, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock. Eligible EIP common shares convert into the right to receive Diffusion common stock at the exchange ratio. Cash is payable only in lieu of fractional Diffusion shares. Excluded and dissenting shares receive different treatment.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per EIP common share is stated. In lieu of a fractional Diffusion common share, a former EIP stockholder receives cash, without interest, equal to the fractional share multiplied by the volume-weighted average closing trading price of Diffusion common stock on Nasdaq for the ten consecutive trading days ending on the second trading day before the merger closing date.
stock_exchange_ratio: Estimated updated ratio: approximately 0.1659 pre-reverse-split shares of Diffusion common stock per 1 share of EIP common stock, after the June 2023 amendment establishing a $1.47-per-share conversion price for EIP convertible notes and the July 2023 EIP share issuance. If a reverse split occurs, the estimated ratio ranges from approximately 0.0207 post-split Diffusion shares per EIP common share at a 1-for-8 split to approximately 0.1106 at a 1-for-1.5 split. The final ratio is determined under the merger agreement formula, including adjustments for the parties’ capitalization, any reverse split and Diffusion’s net cash immediately before closing; it increases if Diffusion’s net cash is below $13.5 million and decreases if net cash exceeds $14.5 million. No fractional Diffusion shares will be issued.
shareholder_vote_date: Diffusion stockholders’ special meeting is scheduled for 8/15/2023 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time to vote on the stock issuance and resulting change of control, and on the proposed reverse split. EIP stockholders will vote by written consent rather than at a meeting; no calendar date for those consents is stated. The merger agreement calls for EIP to obtain sufficient written consents no later than one business day after the Form S-4 registration statement becomes effective.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible waiver of the merger agreement’s conditions: required Diffusion stockholder approval of the stock issuance and, if applicable, reverse split; required EIP stockholder approval of the merger agreement, merger and related transactions; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without a stop order or threatened stop-order proceeding; continued Nasdaq listing of existing Diffusion shares and approval for listing of the merger shares and, if required, the initial listing application; and absence of an order prohibiting the merger or a law making it illegal. Party-specific conditions include the specified accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, delivery of required certificates and documents, and absence of a material adverse effect. EIP’s preferred stock and convertible notes must convert into EIP common stock; specified EIP investor agreements must terminate; applicable lock-up agreements must remain effective; and EIP must provide satisfactory evidence that its National Institute on Aging funding mechanism is in effect. Diffusion must have at least $12.0 million in net cash as calculated under the merger agreement, establish the agreed board composition and provide specified resignations. Required stockholder approvals, registration-statement effectiveness and absence of a prohibitory order or injunction cannot be waived; the other closing conditions may be waived by the applicable party.
event_status: Pending as of the filing; the merger agreement was signed on 3/30/2023, but closing remained subject to conditions. The EIP convertible notes were amended in June 2023 to establish a $1.47-per-share conversion price for the merger.
security_description: EIP Pharma, Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, outstanding immediately before the merger effective time, including shares resulting from conversion of EIP Series A-1, Series A-2 and Series B preferred stock and EIP convertible notes. Certain excluded and dissenting shares are excepted. EIP options and warrants are assumed and adjusted separately rather than receiving this share consideration.
effective_date: No calendar date stated. The merger will become legally effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by Diffusion and EIP and specified in that certificate. Closing is to occur within three business days after the closing conditions are satisfied or waived.
available_options: No holder election; eligible EIP common shares convert into the right to receive Diffusion common stock under the exchange ratio, with cash only in lieu of fractional Diffusion shares. Properly dissenting holders may pursue statutory appraisal rights instead.

acquirer: Trident-Sun TopCo, Inc. (Parent), a wholly owned subsidiary of 3D Systems Corporation; Shemesh Printing Merger Company 2023 Ltd. is Parent’s merger subsidiary for this merger.
consideration_type: Elective consideration: eligible holders of Stratasys ordinary shares may elect mixed cash and stock, cash only, or stock only, subject to the agreement’s allocation and proration rules.
cash_consideration: Mixed election or no valid election: USD $7.50 per Stratasys ordinary share. Cash election: cash per share equal to USD $7.50 plus 1.5444 multiplied by the Parent Common Stock Reference Price, rounded to two decimal places, subject to proration if cash elections exceed the available cash election amount; prorated holders also receive stock. Stock election: generally no cash, but holders receive a prorated cash amount if the available cash election amount exceeds cash elections. Cash is paid instead of any fractional Parent share otherwise issuable, calculated using the closing price of 3D Systems common stock on the last trading day before the mergers become effective.
stock_exchange_ratio: Mixed election or no valid election: 1.5444 shares of Trident-Sun TopCo, Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, per 1 Stratasys Ltd. ordinary share, nominal amount NIS 0.01. Stock election: 1.5444 plus USD $7.50 divided by the Parent Common Stock Reference Price, with the quotient rounded to four decimal places, shares of Parent common stock per 1 Stratasys ordinary share, subject to the stated proration rule if available cash exceeds cash elections. Prorated cash electors receive stock determined using the stock-election ratio and cash fraction. The reference price is the five-consecutive-trading-day volume-weighted average closing price of 3D Systems common stock on the NYSE ending on the second full trading day before closing, rounded to four decimal places. The consideration is subject to adjustment for the specified changes in outstanding shares before the effective times. No fractional Parent shares are issued; cash is paid instead.
closing_conditions: If the merger agreement becomes binding and effective under the Escrow Letter, closing is subject to satisfaction or waiver of conditions including approval by Stratasys shareholders and 3D Systems stockholders; NYSE listing authorization for Parent common stock; expiration or termination of the HSR Act waiting period and any agreement with the DOJ or FTC not to consummate the mergers; other required regulatory approvals or expiration of applicable waiting periods; effectiveness of the Form S-4 without a stop order or proceedings seeking one; absence of legal restraints or laws preventing or prohibiting the mergers; 50 days after filing the Stratasys merger proposal with the Israeli Companies Registrar and 30 days after approval by the shareholders of Stratasys and its merger subsidiary; the specified accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, and absence of a continuing material adverse effect for each company; and Parent’s receipt of the ISA Offering No-Action Letter. There is no condition concerning the parties’ ability to obtain financing.
event_status: Proposed; 3D Systems and its merger entities delivered executed signature pages in escrow, but Stratasys had not countersigned. The merger agreement was not yet binding or effective and required a qualifying termination of the Stratasys–Desktop Metal merger agreement followed by Stratasys’s execution and delivery of its signature page.
security_description: Stratasys Ltd. ordinary shares, nominal amount NIS 0.01 each, issued and outstanding immediately before the Stratasys merger effective time, excluding the specified treasury shares and shares held by 3D Systems, Parent, the merger subsidiaries, or a Stratasys subsidiary. Stratasys 102 Shares are not eligible to elect and are treated as stock-electing shares, with consideration deposited with the Stratasys 102 Trustee.
effective_date: Conditional: the Stratasys merger becomes effective when the Israeli Companies Registrar issues its certificate of merger. The parties intend to use reasonable best efforts for this to occur on the closing date, immediately after the 3D Systems merger becomes effective. No calendar date is stated.
available_options: Mixed election: USD $7.50 cash and 1.5444 Parent common shares per Stratasys ordinary share. Cash election: cash equal to USD $7.50 plus 1.5444 multiplied by the Parent Common Stock Reference Price per share, subject to proration into cash and stock if cash elections exceed available cash. Stock election: Parent common shares per share equal to 1.5444 plus USD $7.50 divided by the reference price, subject to proration into cash and stock if available cash exceeds cash elections. Aggregate cash and stock consideration does not vary with individual preferences. Stratasys 102 Shares cannot elect and are treated as stock-electing shares.
default_option: A Stratasys ordinary share with no valid election by the deadline is deemed a mixed-consideration electing share and receives USD $7.50 cash and 1.5444 Parent common shares, subject to the agreement’s terms. An election determined to be improperly made, revoked, or lost is ineffective and receives the same treatment.
election_deadline: 5:00 p.m. Eastern time on a date the parties agree is as near as practicable to three business days before closing, or another time or date mutually agreed in writing. The date is to be announced at least five business days beforehand. A waiver of the deadline must apply to all holders, be publicly disclosed on an agreed date, and have 3D Systems’ prior written consent.

cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per NexTier common share. consideration_type: Stock: each eligible share of Dianthus common stock, including common stock issued upon conversion of Dianthus preferred stock and in the Dianthus pre-closing financing, will convert into the right to receive Magenta common stock. Dissenting shares and shares canceled under the Merger Agreement are excluded.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per Dianthus share is specified. No cash will be paid for a fractional share of Magenta common stock eliminated by rounding.
stock_exchange_ratio: Currently estimated at approximately 3.64 shares of Magenta common stock per 1 share of Dianthus common stock, before the proposed Magenta reverse stock split. The final exchange ratio is the Dianthus merger shares divided by Dianthus outstanding shares, rounded to eight decimal places, and is subject to adjustment based on Magenta’s net cash at closing and proceeds of the Dianthus pre-closing financing. Fractional Magenta shares will not be issued; each holder’s aggregate fractional entitlement will be rounded to the nearest whole share.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted, waiver of the Merger Agreement’s conditions, including: Magenta stockholder approval of the Nasdaq stock issuance/change-of-control proposal and reverse stock split proposal; Dianthus stockholder approval by the specified common-stock, preferred-stock and Series A preferred-stock voting thresholds; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an outstanding stop order or proceeding seeking one, and compliance with applicable material state securities laws; absence of an effective legal restraint or law making the merger or related transactions illegal; Nasdaq approval to list the Magenta shares issued in the merger; and continued effectiveness of specified lock-up agreements. Each party’s additional conditions include the other party’s required representation and warranty accuracy, material covenant compliance, closing documents and absence of a material adverse effect. Magenta’s obligation also requires the Dianthus stockholder written consent and at least $70 million in proceeds from the Dianthus pre-closing financing received or receivable substantially simultaneously with closing. The filing states that Dianthus’ obligation is not conditioned on Magenta having a specified level of closing net cash.
event_status: Pending as of the July 17, 2023 filing. The merger agreement was signed on May 2, 2023; completion remained subject to stockholder approvals and other closing conditions.
security_description: Dianthus Therapeutics, Inc. common stock, including shares issued upon conversion of Dianthus preferred stock and shares issued in the Dianthus pre-closing financing; excludes shares canceled under the Merger Agreement and dissenting shares.
effective_date: No exact date or time specified. The merger will become effective when a certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by Magenta and Dianthus and specified in that certificate. The merger was anticipated to close in the third quarter of 2023, but the exact timing could not be predicted.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Dianthus common shares convert into the right to receive Magenta common stock under the Merger Agreement.

acquirer: Phoenix Biotech Acquisition Corp. (PBAX), through its wholly-owned subsidiary PBCE Merger Sub, Inc., which will merge into CERo Therapeutics, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; each outstanding CERo common share converts into the right to receive PBAX Class A common stock and a contingent right to additional PBAX Class A common shares if earnout targets or a change of control occur.
stock_exchange_ratio: Each CERo common share converts into the right to receive PBAX Class A common shares equal to the Exchange Ratio, rounded down to the nearest whole share. The Exchange Ratio is ($50,000,000 minus the Aggregate Liquidation Preference) divided by the Fully Diluted Company Capitalization, then divided by $10.00; it was approximately 0.026 as of 5/1/2023. CERo common stockholders also have a pro rata contingent right to additional Class A common shares under the stated earnout and change-of-control conditions.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, waiver by the party benefiting from the condition: expiration, termination or receipt of applicable HSR Act waiting periods or consent; absence of a legal restraint preventing closing; effectiveness of the registration statement without an outstanding SEC stop order or pending stop-order proceeding; requisite CERo and PBAX stockholder approvals and PBAX's approval as sole stockholder of Merger Sub; Nasdaq approval of PBAX's initial listing application and Class A common shares, and satisfaction of applicable Nasdaq listing requirements; and at least $5,000,001 of New CERo net tangible assets immediately after the effective time. PBAX and Merger Sub additionally require CERo's representations and warranties and covenant compliance to meet the agreement's standards, no continuing Company Material Adverse Effect, and a CERo officer's certificate. CERo additionally requires the SPAC parties' representations and warranties and covenant compliance to meet the agreement's standards, at least $30.0 million in Available Closing Cash, no continuing SPAC Material Adverse Effect, and a PBAX officer's certificate. Available Closing Cash includes trust funds after stockholder redemptions plus PIPE funds, less unpaid SPAC and company expenses; no PIPE subscription agreements had been executed as described in the filing.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was signed on 6/4/2023 and stockholder approvals and other closing conditions remained outstanding in this preliminary proxy statement/prospectus.
security_description: Outstanding common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, of CERo Therapeutics, Inc.; treasury shares are cancelled without consideration, and properly dissenting shares receive appraisal treatment instead of merger consideration.
available_options: No holder election

acquirer: Talaris Therapeutics, Inc. (through Terrain Merger Sub, Inc., its direct wholly owned merger subsidiary)
consideration_type: Stock; eligible outstanding Tourmaline stock options will be assumed and converted into options to purchase Talaris common stock.
cash_consideration: No cash is payable for fractional shares of Talaris common stock eliminated by rounding; no cash merger consideration per Tourmaline share is stated.
stock_exchange_ratio: Estimated at 0.7592 shares of Talaris common stock per 1 share of Tourmaline common stock, before the proposed reverse stock split. The final Exchange Ratio is the quotient of Tourmaline Merger Shares divided by Tourmaline Outstanding Shares, rounded to four decimal places. It is subject to adjustment for the reverse stock split, Talaris net cash below $62,437,500 or above $72,562,500, and Talaris Legacy Proceeds. No fractional Talaris shares or cash for fractional shares will be issued.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where legally permitted, written waiver of applicable conditions: effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an outstanding stop order or proceeding; no effective legal restraint or law making the transactions illegal; Talaris stockholder approval of the stock issuance and reverse stock split; Tourmaline stockholder approval of the merger agreement and merger; Nasdaq approval of the listing of additional Talaris shares, including merger shares; required accuracy of the other party’s representations and warranties, material compliance with its covenants, and delivery of required closing documents; no continuing material adverse effect on Tourmaline or Talaris, as applicable; applicable lock-up agreements remaining effective; termination of Tourmaline investor agreements for Talaris’s obligation; and required post-merger governance appointments for Tourmaline’s obligation. The $75 million Tourmaline pre-closing financing is expected immediately before closing and is itself conditioned on the merger closing conditions, but is not stated here as a merger closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was signed on June 22, 2023, and closing remained subject to conditions in the July 19, 2023 preliminary proxy statement/prospectus.
security_description: Tourmaline Bio, Inc. common stock, $0.0001 par value per share, including common stock issued upon conversion of Tourmaline preferred stock and in the Tourmaline pre-closing financing. Treasury shares and dissenting shares are excluded from ordinary merger consideration; eligible Tourmaline options receive separate option treatment.
effective_date: Not yet determined. The merger will become legally effective upon filing a certificate of merger with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by Talaris and Tourmaline and specified in that certificate. The merger was anticipated to close in the fourth quarter of 2023, but its exact timing could not be predicted.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Tourmaline shares are converted into the right to receive Talaris common stock at the Exchange Ratio, subject to the stated exclusions and adjustments.

consideration_type: Stock, with contingent additional stock earnout shares for eligible recipients. Dissenting shares are excluded from the stock conversion.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration is stated for Set Jet common stock. Cash may be paid solely instead of fractional shares, if the applicable fractional-share treatment provides for it; the merger agreement instead states that fractional shares of Revelstone Class A common stock will be rounded to the nearest whole share.
stock_exchange_ratio: Each eligible share of Set Jet common stock converts into a number of shares of Revelstone Class A common stock equal to the Closing Exchange Ratio: Closing Merger Consideration Shares divided by Fully Diluted Company Shares. Closing Merger Consideration Shares equal 5,703,000, increased or decreased by 0.10 share for each $1 by which Set Jet's debt for borrowed money net of cash and cash equivalents at closing is below or above $14,970,000, respectively, with each adjustment product rounded down to a whole share. Fractional shares resulting from the conversion are rounded to the nearest whole share after aggregation for each holder. Eligible earnout recipients may receive up to 4,500,000 additional shares in the aggregate if specified stock-price or change-in-control triggers occur.
