consideration_type: Stock, including a contingent right to additional common shares upon achievement of specified milestones. Profusa preferred shares convert into Profusa common shares immediately before the merger; Profusa options and convertible notes have separate treatment.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each issued and outstanding share of Profusa common stock, including common stock resulting from preferred-stock conversion, NorthView common stock equal to the Exchange Ratio. The Exchange Ratio is the Profusa Reference Share Value divided by $10.00 per NorthView share. The Profusa Reference Share Value is based on a $155,000,000 Profusa equity value, subject to the stated adjustments for option and warrant exercise amounts, inducements, convertible notes and fully diluted Profusa shares. The numerical ratio is not stated. Fractional NorthView shares are rounded to the nearest whole share, with 0.5 rounded up.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible waiver: approval of the required NorthView proposals and Profusa stockholder approval; no effective governmental prohibition; completion of required HSR filings and expiration or termination of the applicable waiting period; specified governmental consents; an effective Form S-4 registration statement without a stop order or threatened suspension proceeding; at least $5,000,001 of NorthView net tangible assets after redemptions; and any pre-closing non-redemption agreements delivered and effective. NorthView and Merger Sub additionally require Profusa's representations and warranties to meet the applicable standards, material covenant compliance, an officer's certificate, no continuing Profusa material adverse effect, specified lock-up agreements and closing deliverables. Profusa additionally requires the corresponding NorthView and Merger Sub representations, warranties and covenant compliance, an officer's certificate, no continuing NorthView material adverse effect, Nasdaq listing and approval of the listing application without notice of listing non-compliance, NorthView closing deliverables, and NorthView cash on hand of at least $15,000,000. The filing states that NorthView and Profusa have filed the required HSR forms and that a statutory HSR waiting period expired; it does not establish that every closing condition has been satisfied.
event_status: Pending as of the July 21, 2023 filing; the merger agreement was executed on November 7, 2022, and completion is not assured.
security_description: Issued and outstanding Profusa, Inc. common stock, including Profusa common stock issued upon conversion of its preferred stock immediately before the merger; treasury shares are canceled without consideration, and dissenting shares are subject to appraisal-rights treatment.
effective_date: Expected when a certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware and California Secretaries of State, or at a later time agreed by the parties and specified in that certificate. The filing is to occur as promptly as practicable, but no later than three business days after satisfaction or permissible waiver of the applicable conditions. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election for the stated merger consideration.

acquirer: EF Hutton Acquisition Corporation I (Parent); its wholly-owned subsidiary, EFHAC Merger Sub, Inc., will merge into the target.
target: Humble Imports Inc, d/b/a ECD Auto Design
consideration_type: Mixed cash and stock, subject to the terms of the Merger Agreement and customary adjustments.
cash_consideration: An aggregate of USD $15,000,000 payable to ECD securityholders. Per share of Company Common Stock, the Closing Per Share Cash Consideration is $15,000,000 divided by the Fully Diluted Company Shares; no numeric per-share amount is stated.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of Humble Imports Inc Company Common Stock, a number of shares of EF Hutton Acquisition Corporation I Parent Common Stock equal to the Closing Exchange Ratio: 21,000,000 Closing Merger Consideration Shares divided by the Fully Diluted Company Shares. The stock consideration and ratio are subject to adjustment for specified changes to Parent Common Stock before issuance. Fractional Parent shares resulting from conversion of Company Capital Stock are rounded up to the nearest whole share after aggregating a holder’s shares.
closing_conditions: Conditions include no effective law or order making the transaction illegal or prohibiting it, and no governmental action commenced or asserted in writing to enjoin or materially restrict closing; Company Stockholder Approval and approval of the Required Parent Proposals; conditional Nasdaq approval of Parent’s initial listing application, satisfaction of applicable listing requirements immediately after the Effective Time, no notice of noncompliance, and approval of Parent Common Stock for listing; effectiveness of Form S-4 without an outstanding SEC stop order or pending proceeding seeking one; and Parent Closing Cash of at least $65,000,000. Parent Closing Cash comprises trust cash after redemption payments plus PIPE financing actually received, without deduction of transaction fees or expenses. The filing also describes a $5,000,001 net tangible assets condition upon closing after redemptions and PIPE financing that cannot be waived. Additional conditions include material covenant compliance, accuracy of representations and warranties under the agreement’s standards, absence of a continuing material adverse effect, required closing certificates and agreements, no more than 5% of Company Capital Stock constituting Dissenting Shares, specified Company consents and financial statements, completion of the UK Contribution, effectiveness of the Amended Parent Charter, Parent director resignations, and the specified post-closing board composition. Conditions are subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted; the Parent Closing Cash condition may be waived by ECD in its sole discretion. The UK Contribution is described as completed on June 7, 2023. The filing states that the pro forma redemption scenarios would not meet the conditions necessary to close absent modification or waiver.
event_status: Pending as described in the preliminary proxy statement/prospectus; the merger agreement was signed on March 3, 2023, and the UK Contribution was completed, but merger closing remained subject to conditions.
security_description: Humble Imports Inc Company Common Stock, described in the Merger Agreement as common stock with no par value per share. The conversion terms exclude shares cancelled because they are held by Parent, Merger Sub, their subsidiaries, or the Company or its subsidiaries, and exclude Dissenting Shares from ordinary conversion.
effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. The Merger becomes effective upon the later of filing the Certificate of Merger with the Florida Secretary of State and any later date and time agreed by the parties and specified in that certificate. Closing is separately described as occurring, unless otherwise agreed, on the second Business Day after satisfaction or permissible waiver of Article IX conditions.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible share of Company Common Stock is converted into the right to receive the specified cash-and-stock consideration, subject to the stated exclusions.

acquirer: Deep Medicine Acquisition Corp. (acquiring parent); DMAC Merger Sub Inc. is its wholly-owned subsidiary that will merge with and into TruGolf, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock: TruGolf common stockholders will receive Deep Medicine Acquisition Corp. common stock and a contingent right to receive additional Class A common shares if specified earnout milestones are met. TruGolf Class A common stock is exchanged for purchaser Class A common stock; if TruGolf Class B common stock is created and outstanding, it is exchanged for purchaser Class B common stock. Outstanding TruGolf options will be assumed as options to purchase purchaser Class A common stock. Treasury shares and dissenting shares receive different treatment.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each share of TruGolf common stock, a number of shares of Deep Medicine Acquisition Corp. common stock equal to the Conversion Ratio: Per Share Price divided by the Purchaser Share Price of $10.00 per share, subject to the stated equitable adjustments. Per Share Price equals Adjusted Merger Consideration divided by Fully-Diluted Company Shares; Adjusted Merger Consideration equals Merger Consideration plus the aggregate exercise prices of all Company Options. Merger Consideration starts with $80,000,000 and is adjusted for net working capital relative to a $1,000,000 target, Closing Net Debt and unpaid Company Transaction Expenses; it is subject to a post-closing adjustment. TruGolf Class A common stock is exchanged for purchaser Class A common stock; TruGolf Class B common stock, if issued under the proposed amended charter, is exchanged for purchaser Class B common stock. No fractional purchaser shares will be issued; each holder’s aggregate fractional entitlement will be rounded down to the nearest whole share.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver, where permissible, by TruGolf and Deep Medicine Acquisition Corp.: required purchaser and TruGolf stockholder approvals; expiration or termination of applicable antitrust waiting periods; required governmental approvals and specified third-party consents; no effective law or order making the transactions illegal or preventing or prohibiting them; at closing, at least $10,000,000 in purchaser cash and cash equivalents, including remaining trust funds after redemptions and any PIPE proceeds, after amounts owed to the Sponsor and affiliates but before Transaction Expenses not exceeding $1,600,000 (proceeds of purchaser convertible notes and any forward purchase agreement count); election or appointment of the post-closing purchaser board; and an effective registration statement with no stop or similar order. TruGolf’s additional conditions include the purchaser’s representations and warranties meeting the agreement’s standard, material compliance with obligations and covenants, no continuing uncured purchaser Material Adverse Effect, and specified certificates, a registration rights agreement and an effective amended purchaser charter. The purchaser’s additional conditions include TruGolf’s representations and warranties meeting the agreement’s standard, material compliance with obligations and covenants, no continuing uncured TruGolf Material Adverse Effect, effective lock-up and non-competition agreements, and specified certificates, employment agreements, stockholder transmittal documents, cancellation of convertible securities other than assumed options, and termination of specified related-party contracts.
event_status: Pending; the original merger agreement was amended and restated on 7/21/2023. The filing describes the business combination as proposed and subject to closing conditions.
security_description: TruGolf, Inc. common stock: Class A common stock and, if created and outstanding under the proposed amended company charter, Class B common stock. Treasury shares are cancelled without payment; dissenting shares are subject to appraisal treatment. Outstanding TruGolf options are assumed and converted into options to purchase purchaser Class A common stock rather than receiving the common-stock exchange consideration.
effective_date: Upon filing the Articles of Merger with the Nevada Secretary of State, or at a later time specified in those articles; no calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election

cash_consideration: The amended merger terms eliminate cash consideration payable to Better stockholders, other than cash in lieu of fractional shares.

shareholder_vote_date: Aurora shareholders’ extraordinary general meeting was scheduled for 8/11/2023 at 9:30 a.m. Eastern Time. Better stockholder approval was to be obtained by written consent; no consent date is stated.
closing_conditions: Conditions, subject to satisfaction or applicable waiver, include Aurora and Better stockholder approvals; effectiveness of the registration statement without a stop order; required regulatory approvals, including applicable state, mortgage and insurance authorities and approvals involving Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA and VA; expiration or termination of the HSR Act waiting period; no final, non-appealable governmental restraint or law making the Mergers illegal or preventing them; Aurora having at least $5,000,001 in net tangible assets; Nasdaq listing approval for the shares to be issued; completion of Aurora’s Delaware Domestication; the Minimum Cash Condition; required accuracy of representations and warranties and material performance of covenants; and no Better Material Adverse Effect. acquirer: Inpixon (parent); Superfly Merger Sub Inc. is its wholly owned merger subsidiary.
consideration_type: Stock for eligible outstanding XTI common shares, subject to the Exchange Ratio and the stated exclusions for cancelled and dissenting shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration is specified for XTI common shares. Fractional shares of Inpixon common stock will not be issued; a holder's share amount will instead be rounded up to the nearest whole share.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of XTI Aircraft Company common stock, the holder receives a number of shares of Inpixon common stock equal to the variable Exchange Ratio. The ratio is calculated as [((Parent Fully-Diluted Shares Outstanding less Parent Financing Adjustment Shares) divided by Adjustment Percentage) less (Parent Fully-Diluted Shares Outstanding less Parent Financing Adjustment Shares)] divided by Company Fully-Diluted Shares Outstanding. Adjustment Percentage is 40% less Net Cash Adjustment Percentage less Note Adjustment Percentage; those adjustments reflect the stated parent net cash, loan and Streeterville-note formulas. No fractional Inpixon shares will be issued; each holder's resulting share amount will be rounded up to the nearest whole share.
shareholder_vote_date: XTI Aircraft Company stockholders approved the merger by written consent received within 24 hours after execution of the 7/24/2023 merger agreement; the exact consent date is not stated. Inpixon stockholder approval remained required, but no merger-vote meeting date is stated.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver of applicable conditions: XTI and Inpixon stockholder approvals; required governmental consents; no effective legal prohibition of the merger or Inpixon stock issuance; SEC effectiveness of the Form S-4 without an effective stop order or pending or threatened proceeding; Nasdaq approval of the shares, trading-symbol change and initial listing; materially accurate representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, and no applicable material adverse effect. Additional conditions for Inpixon include completion of the appraisal-demand period with no more than 5% of XTI common shares dissenting, timely XTI written consent, amendment of the Denehy note, release of Xeriant claims, commercially reasonable efforts to amend certain XTI warrants, and amendment of XTI's Chardan fee agreement. XTI's additional condition includes specified Streeterville waivers and approval. The filing states that XTI's written consent was received; it does not establish that the other conditions were satisfied.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was signed and announced, both boards approved it, and XTI stockholder written consent was received. Completion remained conditional, including on Inpixon stockholder approval.
security_description: XTI Aircraft Company common stock, par value $0.001 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger's Effective Time, excluding cancelled treasury or company-owned shares and dissenting shares with perfected appraisal rights. XTI options and warrants have separate assumption provisions and are not the common-share consideration described in this record.
effective_date: Not dated. The merger will become legally effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by XTI and Inpixon and specified in that certificate. The certificate is to be filed on the Closing Date or as soon thereafter as practicable.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible outstanding XTI common share automatically converts into the right to receive Inpixon common stock at the Exchange Ratio, subject to the stated exclusions and fractional-share rounding.

acquirer: Coherus BioSciences, Inc. (parent); Crimson Merger Sub I, Inc. and Crimson Merger Sub II, LLC are its wholly owned merger subsidiaries.
consideration_type: Coherus common stock plus one contingent value right (CVR) per eligible share of Surface common stock. The CVR represents a right to conditional payments, if any, that Coherus may make in cash, additional Coherus common stock, or both, at its discretion. Cash is also payable in lieu of fractional Coherus shares.
cash_consideration: No fixed cash price per share of Surface common stock is stated. Cash in lieu of a fractional Coherus common share equals the fraction multiplied by $5.2831, rounded to the nearest cent, without interest and subject to required tax withholding. Each CVR may produce conditional payments, if any, that Coherus may pay in cash, additional stock, or both; payments depend on specified receipts less permitted deductions and are subject to the CVR Agreement’s payment limitations.
stock_exchange_ratio: A variable number of shares of Coherus common stock per 1 share of Surface common stock: (($40,000,000 plus Surface Net Cash) divided by $5.2831) divided by the number of Surface common shares outstanding immediately before the First Merger’s effective time on the fully diluted and as-converted basis specified in the Merger Agreement. The agreement rounds the Exchange Ratio down to four decimal places. The ratio depends on Surface Net Cash but is not adjusted for changes in either company’s stock price. No fractional Coherus shares will be issued; cash is payable instead.
shareholder_vote_date: Surface stockholders’ special meeting scheduled for 9/7/2023 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time, held virtually, to vote on adoption of the Merger Agreement.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted: Surface stockholder approval of the Merger Agreement; no effective legal restraint or law prohibiting or making the Mergers illegal; approval of the Coherus shares for Nasdaq Global Market listing, subject to official notice of issuance; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an outstanding stop order; execution and continued effectiveness of the CVR Agreement; the specified accuracy of the other party’s representations and warranties, material performance of its covenants, and absence of a material adverse effect on that party. Coherus and the merger subsidiaries additionally require Surface Net Cash of at least $19,600,000, unless Coherus consents in writing to a lower amount. Each party’s obligation is also subject to receipt of the specified officer’s certificate from the other party.
event_status: Pending as of the proxy statement dated 7/26/2023; the Merger Agreement had been executed, but Surface stockholder approval and other closing conditions remained outstanding. Completion was expected in the third quarter of 2023 but was not assured.
security_description: Surface Oncology, Inc. common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the First Merger’s effective time, excluding shares held in Surface’s treasury or owned by Coherus or its merger subsidiaries and shares for which appraisal is properly demanded.
effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. The First Merger becomes effective when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed in writing by Coherus and Surface and specified in that certificate. Promptly after the First Merger, the Second Merger becomes effective upon filing its certificate, or at a similarly agreed and specified later time. The Mergers were expected to be completed in the third quarter of 2023, subject to conditions.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Surface common shares are converted into the specified Coherus stock and one CVR each. Coherus, not the holders, chooses whether any CVR payments are made in cash, additional stock, or both.

acquirer: Perception Capital Corp. II (PCCT), through its direct wholly owned merger subsidiary, Perception Spectaire Merger Sub Corp.
consideration_type: Mixed cash and stock, with a cash component dependent on Available Cash and potentially zero. Eligible Spectaire equityholders may also receive contingent NewCo common stock earnout shares.
cash_consideration: For each eligible share of Spectaire common stock, including shares issued upon conversion of Spectaire convertible notes and preferred stock, cash equals Aggregate Cash Consideration divided by the number of Spectaire common shares issued and outstanding immediately before the merger effective time after those conversions. Aggregate Cash Consideration equals Available Cash minus $5,000,000, capped at $6,250,000, and is zero if Available Cash is $5,000,000 or less. A fixed cash amount per share is not stated.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each eligible share of Spectaire common stock, the number of shares of NewCo common stock equals Aggregate Stock Consideration divided by the number of Spectaire common shares issued and outstanding immediately before the merger effective time after conversion of Spectaire convertible notes and preferred stock. Aggregate Stock Consideration equals (($125,000,000 minus Aggregate Cash Consideration) divided by $10.00) minus Spectaire Award Shares. No fractional NewCo common shares will be issued; after aggregation, a holder’s fractional entitlement is rounded up to the nearest whole share. Eligible equityholders may also receive a pro rata portion of up to 7,500,000 contingent earnout shares.
shareholder_vote_date: Spectaire: the requisite stockholders approved the merger agreement and related transactions by written consent in connection with execution of the agreement; the consent date is not explicitly stated. PCCT: an extraordinary general meeting to vote on the business combination is proposed for an unspecified date and time in 2023.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver of applicable conditions, including PCCT shareholder approval of the cross-conditioned business combination, domestication, organizational documents, director election, stock issuance and equity incentive plan proposals; Spectaire stockholder approval, which the filing states was obtained by written consent; no law restraining or prohibiting closing; and conditional Nasdaq listing approval for NewCo common stock issued in the merger. The former requirement that PCCT have at least $5,000,001 of net tangible assets at closing was waived by the merger parties on March 30, 2023, subject to PCCT shareholder approval, which was obtained April 27, 2023. The obligations of PCCT and Merger Sub also depend on specified accuracy of Spectaire’s representations and warranties, material compliance with Spectaire’s covenants, and no continuing Spectaire material adverse effect after signing. Spectaire’s obligations also depend on specified accuracy of PCCT’s representations and warranties, material compliance with PCCT’s covenants, and completion of the domestication with delivery of the Delaware certificate.
event_status: Pending as of the filing; the merger agreement was executed, Spectaire stockholder approval was obtained by written consent, and PCCT shareholder approval of the proposed business combination remained to be sought.
security_description: Shares of Spectaire Inc. common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger effective time after conversion of Spectaire convertible notes and Series Seed preferred stock. Shares subject to Spectaire options or RSUs, restricted shares, treasury shares and dissenting shares are excluded from this common-share conversion and have separate treatment.
effective_date: Not specified. The merger becomes effective when the Delaware Secretary of State accepts the merger certificate for filing, or at a later time agreed in writing by PCCT and Spectaire and specified in that certificate. Closing is described separately as occurring, unless otherwise agreed, at 7:00 a.m. Pacific Time two business days after applicable closing conditions are satisfied or waived.
available_options: No holder election for the merger consideration is stated; eligible Spectaire common stock is converted into the right to receive its applicable cash and stock consideration and contingent earnout shares, subject to the stated exceptions.

consideration_type: Stock; outstanding Notable common stock converts into the right to receive VBL ordinary shares. Outstanding Notable options and warrants are assumed and converted into options and warrants to purchase VBL ordinary shares, respectively.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration is stated for each share of Notable common stock; the stated merger consideration is VBL ordinary shares. No cash is paid in lieu of fractional VBL ordinary shares; fractional entitlements are rounded up to the nearest whole share.
stock_exchange_ratio: Currently estimated at approximately 2.2482 VBL ordinary shares, nominal value NIS 0.01 each, per 1 share of Notable common stock, par value $0.001, before the proposed VBL reverse share split. closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver of the applicable conditions, including: effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an operative stop order or proceeding seeking one; no effective legal restraint or law making the transactions illegal; requisite VBL shareholder approval of merger-related proposals, including the share issuance and resulting change of control, reverse share split, share capital increase, name change and articles amendment, and requisite Notable stockholder approval of the merger agreement and merger; Nasdaq approval of the additional shares and listing of the merger shares; expiration or termination of applicable Israeli regulatory waiting periods; consummation of Notable's pre-closing financing on the purchase agreement terms with at least $5,000,000 in specified net cash proceeds; and VBL Net Cash of at least $15,000,000 at closing. Additional party-specific conditions include specified accuracy of the other party's representations and warranties, material compliance with its covenants, delivery of required certificates and documents, and absence of a material adverse effect. The agreement also specifies conditions concerning Notable investor agreements and lock-up agreements, IIA undertaking and notice, VBL lock-up agreements, specified employee and contractor terminations, and termination of VBL's Section 401(a) plan. event_status: Pending as described in the July 26, 2023 filing; the merger agreement was executed, but the filing states that the merger's completion remains subject to approvals and other closing conditions and is not assured.

effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. The merger becomes effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time specified in that certificate with VBL's and Notable's consent.
available_options: No holder election; eligible shares of Notable common stock automatically convert into the right to receive VBL ordinary shares, subject to the stated exceptions for canceled and dissenting shares.

acquirer: Frequency Therapeutics, Inc.; its direct, wholly owned subsidiary Frequency Merger Sub, Inc. will merge into Korro Bio, Inc.
target: Korro Bio, Inc., which will survive as a wholly owned subsidiary of Frequency Therapeutics, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock: Korro Bio common stock, including shares issued in the Pre-Closing Financing, converts into the right to receive Frequency common stock. Korro Bio options and warrants are converted into options and warrants to acquire Frequency common stock, respectively.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration for Korro Bio common stock is stated. No cash will be paid for fractional shares eliminated by rounding.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each share of Korro Bio common stock outstanding immediately before the effective time, excluding shares issued in the Pre-Closing Financing, the right to receive Frequency common stock is determined by multiplying the total Korro Merger Shares by the applicable holder’s percentage interest in Korro Bio stated in the Allocation Certificate. Korro Merger Shares equal Post-Closing Frequency Shares multiplied by the Korro Allocation Percentage; Post-Closing Frequency Shares equal Frequency Outstanding Shares divided by the Frequency Allocation Percentage. The allocation percentages depend on the specified Korro Bio equity value, Frequency valuation and Pre-Closing Financing proceeds. Each Korro Bio common share issued in the Pre-Closing Financing instead receives a share of the Pre-Closing Financing Merger Shares based on its holder’s percentage of the financing proceeds. No fixed per-share ratio is stated. Shares are subject to the proposed reverse stock split and contractual adjustments; fractional shares are aggregated before any remainder is eliminated.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver: the requisite Frequency stockholder vote approving the merger share issuance and related proposals, and the requisite Korro Bio stockholder vote adopting the Merger Agreement; no effective legal restraint or law making the transactions illegal; Nasdaq approval to list the additional Frequency shares issued in the merger, with existing Frequency shares continuously listed through closing as an additional condition for Korro Bio; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an outstanding stop order or proceeding seeking one; the stockholder lock-up agreements remaining effective immediately after the effective time; conversion of Korro Bio preferred stock into common stock; the Pre-Closing Financing subscription agreement remaining effective and Korro Bio receiving at least $100 million in cash proceeds at or substantially simultaneously with closing; the specified accuracy of each party’s representations and warranties, material compliance with its covenants, no continuing material adverse effect for either party, and delivery of the specified closing certificates.
event_status: Pending as of the July 27, 2023 filing: the merger agreement was executed on July 14, 2023, and the parties expected closing in the fourth quarter of 2023, subject to conditions.
security_description: Korro Bio, Inc. common stock outstanding immediately before the effective time, including common stock resulting from conversion of its preferred stock and common stock issued in the Pre-Closing Financing. The two common-stock categories have different allocation formulas. Korro Bio options and warrants have separate conversion treatment.
effective_date: Not specified. The merger will become effective when the certificate of merger is filed with and accepted by the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by Frequency and Korro Bio and specified in that certificate.
available_options: No holder election; the Merger Agreement specifies the stock consideration for each category of Korro Bio common stock.

acquirer: PROOF Acquisition Corp I (PACI), through its direct, wholly-owned merger subsidiary PACI Merger Sub, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; each outstanding share of Volato common stock, other than excluded shares, is converted into the right to receive PACI Class A common stock. Dissenting shares instead have appraisal rights, and treasury shares are canceled without payment.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of Volato common stock, a number of shares of PACI Class A common stock equal to the Exchange Ratio. The Exchange Ratio is Aggregate Merger Consideration divided by Partially Diluted Company Capitalization; Aggregate Merger Consideration equals ($190.0 million plus the Aggregate Exercise Price plus the Aggregate Additional Series A-1 Investment Amount) divided by $10.00. The shares issued to each shareholder are rounded up to the nearest whole share; no fractional shares are issued.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where legally permitted, written waiver of applicable conditions: PACI and Volato shareholder approvals; effectiveness of the registration statement without an outstanding SEC stop order or proceeding; approval for listing of the transaction securities on a mutually agreed national exchange, subject only to notice of issuance; absence of a qualifying governmental order or law prohibiting the merger; and expiration or termination of applicable HSR Act waiting periods and receipt of other applicable governmental approvals. PACI and Merger Sub additionally require Volato's representations and warranties to meet the specified standards, material compliance with its covenants, no continuing Company Material Adverse Effect, delivery of specified closing documents, and appraisal rights asserted or preserved by holders of no more than 5% of Volato capital stock on an as-converted basis. Volato additionally requires PACI's representations and warranties to meet the specified standards, material compliance by PACI and Merger Sub with their covenants, no continuing PACI Material Adverse Effect, resignation or removal of noncontinuing PACI directors and officers, and delivery of specified closing documents. PACI also agreed to use reasonable best efforts to have at least $35 million in Available PACI Cash; the cited closing-conditions provisions do not identify that amount as a condition.
event_status: Pending proposed merger; the business combination agreement was entered into on 8/1/2023, and completion remained subject to approvals and other closing conditions.
security_description: Volato, Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the merger effective time, excluding dissenting and treasury shares.
effective_date: Not specified; the merger will become effective at the time specified in the certificates of merger, as mutually agreed by PACI and Volato.
available_options: No holder election; eligible outstanding Volato common shares are converted into the stated stock consideration without stockholder action. Dissenting shares have separate statutory appraisal treatment.

consideration_type: Stock, comprising Class A ordinary shares of TETE TECHNOLOGIES INC. Part of the merger consideration is contingent on quarterly revenue targets; 10% of issued consideration is held in escrow.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each Bradbury Capital Holdings Inc. ordinary share other than a treasury or dissenting share, Class A ordinary shares of TETE TECHNOLOGIES INC equal to the Exchange Ratio: Per Share Merger Consideration divided by $10.00. Per Share Merger Consideration is total Merger Consideration divided by the aggregate fully diluted Holdings ordinary shares. Total Merger Consideration is $1,100,000,000 minus Closing Net Indebtedness, with $235,000,000 payable at closing and $865,000,000 subject to earn-out provisions. For each of four consecutive fiscal quarters after closing, total contingent shares are calculated as 21,625,000 × (Revenue Achieved / $87,000,000); holders receive their allocated portions if earned. Fractional shares are rounded to the nearest whole share, with fractions of 0.50 or greater rounded up. Ten percent of closing consideration and fully earned, issued contingent consideration is held in escrow. Closing consideration is subject to post-closing adjustment.
closing_conditions: Conditions include approval of the required Technology & Telecommunication Acquisition Corporation shareholder proposals and approval by Bradbury Capital Holdings Inc. shareholders; no prohibiting law or order; Nasdaq listing approval; at least $5,000,001 in parent net tangible assets after redemptions and transaction financing; required governmental approvals and filings, including applicable HSR filings and expiration or termination of waiting periods; and completion of the redemption offer. Additional conditions include the applicable representations and warranties, covenant compliance and absence of continuing material adverse effects; completion of Super Apps Holdings Sdn. Bhd.'s acquisition of 60% of OneShop Retail Sdn. Bhd.; execution and effectiveness of the specified MobilityOne shareholders and collaboration agreements; and at least $5,000,000 in Closing Parent Cash before parent transaction expenses. Conditions may be waived where permitted.

closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible written waiver by ClimateRock and E.E.W. Eco Energy World Limited: requisite ClimateRock shareholder approval; expiration or termination of applicable antitrust waiting periods; no law or order prohibiting the transactions; at least $5,000,001 of ClimateRock net tangible assets after redemption requests; an effective Form F-4 registration statement without a pending stop-order proceeding; approval of Pubco’s Nasdaq Capital Market listing application and Pubco ordinary-share listing, with applicable listing requirements satisfied; and Pubco’s offer for EEW shares declared wholly unconditional. EEW’s additional conditions include specified representations and warranties of ClimateRock, Pubco and Merger Sub being accurate at the applicable standards; ClimateRock’s material covenant compliance; no continuing, uncured material adverse effect on ClimateRock; and at least $40,000,000 of ClimateRock cash and cash equivalents at closing after redemptions and transaction expenses, including any PIPE proceeds. ClimateRock’s additional conditions include specified EEW representations and warranties being accurate at the applicable standards; EEW’s material covenant compliance; no continuing, uncured material adverse effect on the target companies; delivery of EEW’s certificate of incorporation on re-registration; and written confirmation that EEW informed the UK Takeover Panel of that re-registration.

security_description: ClimateRock Class A ordinary shares, par value $0.0001 per share, that are not redeemed or converted in the Redemption, and ClimateRock Class B ordinary shares, par value $0.0001 per share. Treasury shares are canceled without conversion or payment.
effective_date: Conditional upon closing and required filings: the merger becomes effective when the Cayman Islands Registrar of Companies registers the Plan of Merger, or on another date agreed in writing by ClimateRock and EEW and specified in the Plan of Merger, no later than the 90th day after registration. available_options: No holder election between forms of merger consideration is stated; the applicable outstanding shares convert into Pubco ordinary shares, except Class A shares redeemed or converted in the separate Redemption.

The merger is not subject to a financing condition.

acquirer: Murano Global Investments Limited (PubCo), through its wholly owned merger subsidiary Murano Global Cayman (New CayCo)
consideration_type: Stock; eligible holders of HCM ordinary shares receive PubCo ordinary shares, subject to cash settlement solely for fractional shares.
cash_consideration: Cash is payable only in lieu of fractional PubCo ordinary shares eliminated by rounding down; no per-share cash amount is stated.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 new PubCo ordinary share per 1 HCM ordinary share, so far as legally possible. This applies to HCM Class A and Class B ordinary shares issued and outstanding immediately before the Effective Time, excluding redeemed shares and treasury shares. Fractional PubCo shares are rounded down to the nearest whole share, with cash settlement for the fraction.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver, as permitted, of the agreement’s closing conditions. Conditions for all parties include HCM shareholder approval, completion of the Reorganization, COFECE antitrust approval, no applicable governmental restraint prohibiting the merger, HCM’s business-combination deadline not having passed, the specified PubCo board composition, Nasdaq listing approval and compliance, an effective Registration Statement without an outstanding SEC stop order or proceeding, and expiration of the specified 20-day dissent-election period if a qualifying written objection is made. Additional conditions for HCM include the Murano Parties’ representations and warranties being true and correct as specified, performance of their covenants, specified consents and property certificates, Company and New CayCo shareholder approvals, delivery of transfer, assignment and termination documents, completion of the Subscriptions, Reorganization and PubCo Reorganization, and no continuing Company Material Adverse Effect. Additional conditions for the Murano Parties include the specified accuracy of HCM’s representations and warranties and HCM’s material compliance with its covenants.
event_status: Pending; the business combination agreement was amended and restated on 8/2/2023, replacing the earlier agreement to change the transaction structure.
security_description: HCM Acquisition Corp Class A ordinary shares and Class B ordinary shares, each with par value $0.0001 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the Effective Time, excluding redeemed shares and treasury shares.
effective_date: Conditional: the merger becomes effective when the Cayman Islands Registrar of Companies registers the Plan of Merger, or at a later time permitted by Cayman Islands law, agreed in writing by HCM and Murano PV, S.A. de C.V., and specified in the Plan of Merger. No calendar date or clock time is stated.
available_options: No holder election among merger consideration types is described; eligible HCM ordinary-share holders receive the specified PubCo shares. Separately, eligible HCM Class A holders may elect redemption under HCM’s governing documents in connection with shareholder approval or an extension.

security_description: Outstanding shares of Broad Capital Acquisition Corp. common stock, par value $0.000001 per share; Company Units comprising one Company Share and one Company Right; and Company Rights. Company treasury shares, if any, are treated separately.
effective_date: The Redomestication Merger will become effective when the Delaware Secretary of State accepts the Redomestication Merger Certificate, or at a later time specified in that certificate; no calendar date or clock time is stated.
available_options: Eligible holders of public Company Shares may separately elect cash redemption or retain their Company Shares for the one-for-one stock conversion. Redemption is available regardless of how the holder votes; a holder who redeems Company Shares retains any Company Rights. Holders of public Company Units must separate the underlying Company Shares and Company Rights before redeeming the shares. Redemption of public shares is subject to the 15% holder-or-group limit and the Company's net-tangible-assets limitation. No consideration election is stated for Company Rights.

acquirer: Innovative International Acquisition Corp. (IOAC), through its wholly owned merger subsidiary, Innovative International Merger Sub, Inc. IOAC is expected to be renamed Zoomcar Holdings, Inc. in connection with the transaction.
consideration_type: Stock. Zoomcar stockholders are to receive New Zoomcar common stock, subject to the merger-consideration adjustments. Additional stock earnout consideration is contingent on specified share-price targets or a qualifying change of control.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each share of Zoomcar common stock held after conversion of Zoomcar preferred stock, New Zoomcar common shares equal to the Conversion Ratio: the Merger Consideration divided by the number of Zoomcar fully diluted shares immediately before the merger effective time, then divided by $10.00. The filing also states that the ratio is expected to be 0.0356 New Zoomcar common shares per 1 Zoomcar common share. The Merger Consideration is subject to adjustments for specified option and warrant exercise prices, private financing and Zoomcar net debt. Fractional New Zoomcar common shares are rounded down to the nearest whole share.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver of the stated conditions: IOAC shareholder approval of the required proposals and Zoomcar stockholder approval; required governmental and third-party consents and approvals and expiration of applicable antitrust waiting periods; no law or order preventing the business combination; completion of IOAC's Delaware domestication; reconstitution of the post-closing board; and SEC effectiveness of the registration statement. The agreement also requires IOAC to have at least $5,000,001 in net tangible assets after redemptions, although the parties expect to waive that condition and propose removing the corresponding charter restriction. Zoomcar may waive its additional conditions, including accuracy of IOAC's representations and warranties, material compliance with its covenants, no continuing uncured material adverse effect on IOAC, delivery of the earnout and Zoomcar India merger-consideration shares into their respective escrow accounts, execution of the escrow and amended registration-rights agreements, Nasdaq listing approval for New Zoomcar common stock, and at least $50 million of IOAC cash and cash equivalents at closing after redemptions and specified closing payments, including eligible financing proceeds but excluding the Ananda Trust Investment and any Private Financing. IOAC may waive its additional conditions, including accuracy of Zoomcar's representations and warranties, material compliance with its covenants, no continuing uncured material adverse effect on Zoomcar and its subsidiaries, the lock-up agreement remaining effective, receipt of Zoomcar's certified charter, execution of applicable employment and escrow agreements and the amended registration-rights agreement, requested director and officer resignations, and termination of certain contracts. Customary certificates and other closing deliverables are also required from both sides. The filing states that the $50 million minimum cash condition had not been waived as of its date and that no transaction permitted to satisfy it had yet been identified, committed or consummated.
event_status: Pending as of the filing; the proposed business combination remained subject to shareholder approvals and other closing conditions.
security_description: Zoomcar, Inc. common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, including shares received in the pre-closing exchange or conversion of Zoomcar preferred stock. The filing separately addresses holders of shares of majority-owned subsidiary Zoomcar India Private Limited: their related New Zoomcar common shares are to be placed in escrow pending applicable legal, contractual and withholding requirements. Zoomcar options and warrants are assumed and converted into New Zoomcar options and warrants, rather than receiving the common-stock consideration described in this record.
effective_date: The merger becomes legally effective when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time specified in that certificate. No calendar date or clock time is stated; the filing says the parties expected completion in the third quarter of 2023.
available_options: No holder election among merger consideration options. Eligible Zoomcar stockholders are to receive New Zoomcar common stock under the merger agreement, subject to the stated adjustments and contingent stock earnout. Separately, qualifying Zoomcar stockholders who do not consent to the merger agreement may pursue statutory appraisal rights instead of accepting the merger consideration.

cash_consideration: Cash election: an amount of cash equal to 95% of the net asset value per share of KMF common stock for each outstanding KMF common share, subject to adjustment and proration so that no more than 7,079,620 KMF common shares receive cash consideration.

stock_exchange_ratio: Shares of post-combination company Class A common stock per 1 Montana Class B Common Unit equal to the Exchange Ratio: Aggregate Merger Consideration divided by Aggregate Fully Diluted Company Common Units. Aggregate Merger Consideration equals the Closing Date Purchase Price divided by $10.00. The Closing Date Purchase Price equals $421,900,000, minus the Dilution Factor if positive, plus the implied value of equity interests issued in the Capital Raise assuming a $10.00 share value. No fractional shares will be issued; each holder's aggregate entitlement will be rounded up to the nearest whole Class A share. The ratio is subject to equitable adjustment for specified changes in Parent common stock before the effective time.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver, as applicable: no effective order or law prohibiting or making the transaction illegal; expiration or termination of applicable HSR Act waiting periods and governmental timing commitments (the filing states the 30-day HSR waiting period expired on 7/20/2023); approval of the required XPDB proposals; approval of Montana preferred holders if needed for their pre-closing conversion; effectiveness of the registration statement without a stop order or threatened SEC stop-order proceeding; and Nasdaq approval of the common stock to be issued, subject only to official notice of issuance. Montana's additional conditions include the specified accuracy of XPDB and Merger Sub representations and warranties, their material covenant compliance, an officer certificate, and Aggregate Transaction Proceeds of at least $85 million; the proceeds condition ceases to apply if the Capital Raise produces at least that amount. XPDB and Merger Sub's additional conditions include the specified accuracy of Montana's representations and warranties, Montana's material covenant compliance, an officer certificate, and no Montana Material Adverse Effect since the merger agreement. Montana will use commercially reasonable efforts to consummate the Capital Raise; the filing does not state that completion of that financing is itself a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was signed on 6/5/2023, and the filing seeks XPDB stockholder approval.
security_description: Montana Technologies LLC Class B Common Units, including units resulting from the pre-effective-time conversion of outstanding Montana Preferred Units. Montana Class A Common Units, Class C Common Units, options and warrants have different treatment.
effective_date: Expected upon filing the certificate of merger with the Delaware Secretary of State on the closing date, or at another date or time mutually agreed in writing and specified in that certificate; no calendar date or time is stated for legal effectiveness.
available_options: No holder election; holders of Montana Class B Common Units receive Class A common stock, subject to the stated contingent earnout opportunity.

cash_consideration: No cash consideration is payable for Montana Class A Common Units under the stated merger terms.
stock_exchange_ratio: Shares of post-combination company Class B common stock per 1 Montana Class A Common Unit equal to the Exchange Ratio: Aggregate Merger Consideration divided by Aggregate Fully Diluted Company Common Units. Aggregate Merger Consideration equals the Closing Date Purchase Price divided by $10.00. The Closing Date Purchase Price equals $421,900,000, minus the Dilution Factor if positive, plus the implied value of equity interests issued in the Capital Raise assuming a $10.00 share value. The ratio is subject to equitable adjustment for specified changes in Parent common stock before the effective time. The filing does not clearly state fractional-share treatment specifically for Class B common stock.

Montana's additional conditions include the specified accuracy of XPDB and Merger Sub representations and warranties, their material covenant compliance, an officer certificate, and Aggregate Transaction Proceeds of at least $85 million; the proceeds condition ceases to apply if the Capital Raise produces at least that amount. XPDB and Merger Sub's additional conditions include the specified accuracy of Montana's representations and warranties, Montana's material covenant compliance, an officer certificate, and no Montana Material Adverse Effect since the merger agreement. Montana will use commercially reasonable efforts to consummate the Capital Raise; the filing does not state that completion of that financing is itself a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was signed on 6/5/2023, and the filing seeks XPDB stockholder approval.

consideration_type: Stock for enGene shares; outstanding enGene warrants are exchanged for New enGene warrants. EnGene equity awards receive rollover equity awards.
stock_exchange_ratio: Each enGene share outstanding immediately before the Amalgamation is exchanged for New enGene Class A common shares at the enGene Exchange Ratio, defined as enGene Per Share Value divided by the $10.25 Reference Price; enGene Per Share Value is Reference Value divided by enGene Fully Diluted Shares, and Reference Value is $90,000,000 plus the aggregate exercise price of enGene options exchanged for rollover awards. Each outstanding enGene warrant is exchanged for New enGene warrants at the enGene Exchange Ratio.
closing_conditions: The business combination is subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver of conditions including the required enGene and FEAC shareholder approvals; the Interim Order and Final Order remaining in acceptable form; applicable specified foreign antitrust waiting periods or consents expiring, terminating or being obtained; absence of legal restraints; effectiveness of the registration statement without a continuing SEC stop order or pending proceeding seeking one; New enGene having at least $5,000,001 in net tangible assets after the transactions, including PIPE and Convertible Bridge financing; approval of New enGene shares and warrants for exchange listing and satisfaction of applicable listing requirements; satisfactory Articles of Arrangement; validly exercised and outstanding arrangement dissent rights covering no more than 10% of enGene shares; and Transaction Support Agreements remaining in force. Additional party-specific conditions include the specified accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, absence of a continuing material adverse effect, and delivery of closing certificates and the executed Registration Rights Agreement.
event_status: Pending; the Business Combination Agreement was executed on May 16, 2023, and completion remained subject to closing conditions.
security_description: EnGene Inc. common shares, non-voting common shares, Class A Preferred shares, Class B Preferred shares and Class C Preferred shares outstanding immediately before the Amalgamation. Outstanding enGene warrants and equity awards have separately described rollover treatment; dissenting shareholders may exercise Arrangement Dissent Rights.
effective_date: Proposed Amalgamation: the Closing Date, when the closing actually occurs; no calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election for the stated exchange of enGene shares. Registered enGene shareholders may instead exercise applicable Arrangement Dissent Rights.

available_options: No holder election; holders receive the merger consideration allocated in the Payment Spreadsheet, subject to the stated treatment of dissenting shares, treasury shares, and options.

consideration_type: Stock, consisting of 10X Capital Venture Acquisition Corp. III common stock, plus additional shares subject to earnout milestones.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each share of American Gene Technologies International Inc. common stock, the holder receives shares of 10X Capital Venture Acquisition Corp. III common stock equal to ($500,000,000 ÷ $10.15) ÷ the aggregate fully diluted number of American Gene Technologies International Inc. common shares immediately before the merger. The denominator includes outstanding common shares after preferred-stock conversion, restricted stock awards, and shares issuable upon outstanding options or warrants. Fractional shares otherwise issuable to a former stockholder are aggregated and rounded up to one whole share. Additional earnout shares equal in total to $300,000,000 ÷ $10.15 are allocated pro rata to common stockholders; one-sixth is released for each specified milestone achieved during the five-year earnout period, and unreleased shares are forfeited after that period.
closing_conditions: The merger is subject to satisfaction or, where legally permitted, written waiver of conditions including expiration or termination of applicable HSR Act waiting periods; specified antitrust approvals and expiration or termination of any governmental agreement not to close; no effective legal restraint prohibiting the transaction; completion of 10X III's shareholder redemption offer; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an outstanding SEC stop order or related proceeding; and required approvals from 10X III shareholders and AGT stockholders. Additional conditions for 10X III include the specified accuracy of AGT's representations and warranties, material compliance with its covenants, delivery of an officer's certificate and applicable ancillary agreements, material completion of the internal reorganization and distribution, no Material Adverse Effect, and receipt of the specified tax opinion. Additional conditions for AGT include the specified accuracy of 10X III's and Merger Sub's representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, delivery of an officer's certificate and applicable ancillary agreements, national-exchange listing approval for the common stock and warrants, specified director and officer resignations, no outstanding indebtedness of 10X III or Merger Sub above $1,000,000 other than the stated exceptions, completion of Delaware redomiciliation, at least $25,000,000 of Available Closing Cash, and delivery of a financing certificate.
event_status: Announced and pending as of the August 9, 2023 announcement; the parties had entered into a merger agreement, and closing remained subject to approvals and other conditions.
security_description: American Gene Technologies International Inc. common stock, including common shares resulting from conversion of its Class A-1, Class B-1, Class C-1, Class D-1, Class E-1 and Class F-1 preferred stock. Restricted stock awards, cancelled shares and dissenting shares have separate treatment.
effective_date: Conditional: the merger takes effect when the Delaware certificate of merger is filed, or at a later time agreed in writing by 10X III and AGT and specified in that certificate. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; eligible common shares convert into the right to receive the specified stock consideration.

acquirer: JFL-Tiger Acquisition Co., Inc. (Parent), through its wholly-owned subsidiary JFL-Tiger Merger Sub, Inc. (Merger Sub)
consideration_type: Cash, subject to applicable withholding taxes; shares with perfected appraisal rights are excluded.
cash_consideration: USD $45.50 in cash, without interest, per share of Heritage-Crystal Clean, Inc. common stock, subject to applicable withholding taxes. Shares with perfected appraisal rights receive treatment under Section 262 of the Delaware General Corporation Law instead. The per-share amount is subject to adjustment for specified changes in outstanding shares before the effective time.
stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration payable to holders of Heritage-Crystal Clean, Inc. common stock.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by applicable law, waiver at or before closing: adoption of the merger agreement by holders of at least 75% of the issued and outstanding Heritage-Crystal Clean, Inc. common stock as of the record date; no effective governmental order restraining, enjoining or otherwise prohibiting the merger, and no applicable law making it illegal or otherwise prohibited; and expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period. Parent’s and Merger Sub’s additional conditions include the specified accuracy standards for the Company’s representations and warranties, the Company’s material compliance with its covenants, no continuing Company material adverse effect since the merger agreement date, and an executive-officer certificate. The Company’s additional conditions include the specified accuracy standards for Parent’s and Merger Sub’s representations and warranties, their material compliance with their obligations, and an officer certificate. Obtaining financing or alternative financing is expressly not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending; merger agreement executed on July 19, 2023, with closing dependent on stated conditions.
security_description: Heritage-Crystal Clean, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share. Restricted stock awards vest and are treated as common stock in the merger; outstanding restricted stock units are cancelled for a cash payment based on the $45.50 per-share merger consideration. Treasury shares and shares owned by Parent, Merger Sub or their respective affiliates are cancelled without consideration; shares with perfected appraisal rights receive separate treatment.
effective_date: Not specified. The merger will become effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later date and time agreed by the parties and specified in that certificate.
available_options: No holder election; eligible shares receive fixed cash consideration, subject to appraisal rights.

acquirer: New Whale Inc. (New PubCo), through its wholly owned merger subsidiary, Whale Merger Sub Inc., which will merge with and into the target.
consideration_type: Stock; each eligible outstanding share of WWE Class A common stock converts into one share of New PubCo Class A common stock. Cancelled WWE shares receive no consideration.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration is specified for eligible WWE Class A common stock in the merger; the stated consideration is one share of New PubCo Class A common stock per share.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 share of New PubCo Class A common stock per 1 share of WWE Class A common stock, excluding cancelled WWE shares. The transaction consideration is subject to equitable adjustment for specified changes to outstanding WWE common stock during the interim period.
shareholder_vote_date: 4/2/2023 — WWE stockholder approval was obtained by Vincent K. McMahon's written consent, rather than at a meeting. No further Endeavor or WWE stockholder action is required.
closing_conditions: Closing is subject to satisfaction or waiver, to the extent permitted by law, of the applicable conditions: WWE stockholder approval (satisfied 4/2/2023); completion of the Pre-Closing Reorganization; no applicable legal restraint prohibiting the transactions or imposing a burdensome effect; requisite antitrust and foreign-investment approvals and expiration or termination of applicable waiting periods without a burdensome effect (reported satisfied); effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective stop order or specified SEC proceeding; Section 12(b) registration and NYSE listing authorization for the New PubCo Class A shares; mailing the information statement/prospectus to WWE stockholders and passage of at least 20 calendar days; required accuracy of the parties' representations and warranties and material compliance with covenants; absence of a continuing HoldCo or WWE Material Adverse Effect, as applicable; delivery of the specified officer certificates and executed ancillary agreements; and delivery of HoldCo audited financial statements meeting the specified 92.5% operating-income threshold (reported satisfied 4/23/2023). Consummation is expressly not subject to a financing condition.
event_status: Pending as of the 8/10/2023 filing; WWE stockholder approval, specified regulatory approvals and the HoldCo audited-financial-statements condition had been satisfied, but the filing describes other closing conditions that must still be satisfied or waived.
security_description: WWE Class A common stock, par value $0.01 per share; outstanding shares other than cancelled WWE shares are affected.
effective_date: No calendar date stated. The merger will become legally effective when the certificate of merger is duly filed with and accepted by the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later date or time agreed by the parties and specified in that certificate.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible outstanding WWE Class A share converts into one New PubCo Class A share.

effective_date: No calendar date stated. The merger will become legally effective when the certificate of merger is duly filed with and accepted by the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later date or time agreed by the parties and specified in that certificate.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible outstanding WWE Class B share converts into one New PubCo Class A share.

acquirer: Barça Media (TopCo), a newly formed Netherlands company; its wholly owned Cayman Islands merger subsidiary, Merger Sub, will merge into Mountain & Co. I Acquisition Corp.
consideration_type: Stock; non-redeemed holders receive TopCo ordinary shares. Dissenting shares and treasury shares are excluded from the ordinary share exchange.
stock_exchange_ratio: 1 TopCo Ordinary Share per 1 Mountain Share, whether a Mountain Class A ordinary share or Mountain Class B ordinary share, through an intermediate conversion into 1 Class A ordinary share of the Surviving Company. The merger consideration is subject to adjustment for specified share dividends, splits, combinations or reclassifications before the merger effective time. Dissenting Mountain Class A shares and treasury shares are excluded.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted, waiver of conditions including required regulatory approvals and related waiting periods; no effective legal restraint; effectiveness of the Form F-4 registration statement without an effective SEC stop order or pending stop-order proceeding; required Mountain shareholder and FCB General Assembly approvals; TopCo net tangible assets of at least $5,000,001 immediately after closing; BP or another FCB affiliate holding at least 51% of TopCo ordinary shares on a fully diluted basis immediately after closing; at least €50 million aggregate cash at TopCo, Mountain and their subsidiaries before transaction expenses; and Nasdaq approval of TopCo's initial listing application and shares. Mountain's additional conditions include specified accuracy of FCB/BP/TopCo/Merger Sub representations, material covenant compliance, no Company Material Adverse Effect, completion of the pre-closing reorganization, authorization of TopCo shares, unpaid Company Expenses not exceeding €10 million, and delivery of specified closing documents. FCB, TopCo and Merger Sub's additional conditions include specified accuracy of Mountain's representations, material covenant compliance, no Mountain Material Adverse Effect, unpaid Mountain Expenses not exceeding €40 million, receipt by the RemainCo Entities of the specified €20,090,497.74 first and second tranches by 8/11/2023 and €19,819,004.54 third tranche by 8/21/2023, subject to the stated partial-payment extension through 8/29/2023, and delivery of specified closing documents.
event_status: Pending; Business Combination Agreement entered into on 8/11/2023, with closing expected in the fourth quarter of 2023 subject to approvals and other conditions.
security_description: Mountain & Co. I Acquisition Corp. Class A ordinary shares and Class B ordinary shares. Dissenting Class A shares and treasury shares receive different treatment.
effective_date: Conditional: the merger becomes effective when the Merger Documents are duly filed with the Cayman Registrar, or at a later date and time agreed by Mountain and FCB and specified in those documents; no calendar date or time is stated.

acquirer: Swiftmerge Acquisition Corp. (parent); IVCP Merger Sub, Inc. is its direct wholly owned merger subsidiary.
consideration_type: Stock plus a contingent right to receive additional Parent Common Shares as Earnout Shares if specified milestones are achieved; incidental cash is payable instead of fractional Parent Common Shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash amount per share is specified for this class. Cash in lieu of a fractional Parent Common Share is the fraction multiplied by USD $10.00, rounded to the nearest whole cent and paid without interest.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of HDL Therapeutics, Inc. preferred stock other than Series X Preferred Stock, Parent Common Shares equal to (the share’s Original Issue Price ÷ $10.00) plus the Conversion Ratio. The Conversion Ratio equals Aggregate Participating Merger Consideration divided by Aggregate Fully Diluted Company Common Stock; Aggregate Participating Merger Consideration equals Aggregate Merger Consideration minus Aggregate Preference Amount. The holder also has a contingent right to Earnout Shares based on its Earnout Pro Rata Share. The Aggregate Merger Consideration and Conversion Ratio are subject to adjustment for specified changes to Parent Common Shares before issuance; fractional Parent Common Shares are not issued.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver where permissible by Swiftmerge and HDL: no applicable law or order restraining, prohibiting or imposing a condition on the merger; expiration or termination of applicable HSR waiting periods and receipt of required governmental approvals; HDL stockholder approval and approval of the Required Parent Proposals by Swiftmerge shareholders; applicable exchange listing approval and requirements; an effective registration statement without an effective SEC stop order or pending unwithdrawn proceeding seeking one; and, after the transaction, at least $5,000,001 in Swiftmerge net tangible assets or an exemption from Securities Act Rule 419. Swiftmerge and Merger Sub additionally require HDL’s material covenant compliance, its representations and warranties to meet the agreement’s specified standards, no continuing HDL Material Adverse Effect, and specified certificates, ancillary agreements and other deliveries, subject to waiver by Swiftmerge. HDL additionally requires Swiftmerge’s and Merger Sub’s material covenant compliance, their representations and warranties to meet the specified standards, no continuing Swiftmerge Material Adverse Effect, domestication at least one Business Day before closing, Aggregate Transaction Proceeds of at least $30,000,000, the specified five-member post-closing Swiftmerge board, and specified certificates, charter filing and ancillary agreements, subject to waiver by HDL. The Aggregate Transaction Proceeds definition deducts redemptions, transaction expenses and specified Series X cash payments from trust cash and financing proceeds; the agreement does not make a particular financing arrangement itself a closing condition.
event_status: Announced and pending; the merger agreement was signed on 8/11/2023, and closing remained subject to conditions.

effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. The merger is to become effective when the Delaware Secretary of State accepts the Certificate of Merger for filing, or at a later time agreed by the parties and specified in that certificate; the Effective Time follows completion of domestication.
available_options: No holder election; holders of this preferred-stock category receive the specified stock consideration and a contingent right to Earnout Shares.

HDL additionally requires Swiftmerge’s and Merger Sub’s material covenant compliance, their representations and warranties to meet the specified standards, no continuing Swiftmerge Material Adverse Effect, domestication at least one Business Day before closing, Aggregate Transaction Proceeds of at least $30,000,000, the specified five-member post-closing Swiftmerge board, and specified certificates, charter filing and ancillary agreements, subject to waiver by HDL. closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or applicable waiver: approval of the required proposals by 10X II shareholders and approval of the merger agreement and, to the extent required, the contemplated transactions by African Agriculture stockholders; completion of the offer to redeem 10X II public shares; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement, with no effective SEC stop order or pending threatened or initiated proceeding seeking one; and absence of a governmental order, law or other legal restraint prohibiting the transaction. Conditions for African Agriculture’s obligation to close additionally include Nasdaq listing approval for the post-domestication common stock and warrants, no more than $1,000,000 of specified outstanding indebtedness of 10X II or Merger Sub other than warrants and working capital loans, at least $10,000,000 of Acquiror Closing Cash, specified director and officer departures, and completion of the domestication. effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. The domestication is to occur at least one day before the merger.
available_options: No holder election among forms of merger consideration is described; eligible African Agriculture common stock converts into the right to receive stock under the exchange-ratio formula, subject to the stated exceptions.

consideration_type: Stock; cash is payable only in lieu of fractional shares. Treasury shares, certain shares owned by either party, and shares held by shareholders who properly exercise dissenters’ rights are excluded from the stock exchange.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per share of CBOA Financial, Inc. common stock. Cash without interest is payable in lieu of a fractional share of Bancorp 34, Inc. common stock, calculated by multiplying the fractional share by $12.16.
stock_exchange_ratio: A fixed ratio of 0.24 shares of Bancorp 34, Inc. voting common stock, par value $0.01 per share, per 1 share of CBOA Financial, Inc. common stock, no par value per share. The ratio is subject to an appropriate and proportionate adjustment for specified changes in capitalization before the merger’s effective time. No fractional shares will be issued; cash will be paid in lieu.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver where permitted: approval of the merger agreement by the requisite votes of both CBOA Financial, Inc. shareholders and Bancorp 34, Inc. stockholders; required regulatory approvals for the merger and bank merger, expiration or termination of statutory waiting periods, and no burdensome condition; required third-party consents where failure to obtain them would reasonably likely have a material adverse effect; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement, no SEC stop order, and required state securities qualifications; authorization of the Bancorp 34 common shares for trading or quotation; no legal restraint prohibiting or making the transactions illegal; and tax opinions regarding reorganization treatment. Each party’s obligation is also subject to specified accuracy standards for the other party’s representations and warranties and the other party’s material compliance with its obligations. Bancorp 34’s obligation is further subject to no more than 7.5% of outstanding CBOA common shares qualifying as dissenting shares, execution of the specified officer agreements without the officers indicating an intent to breach, and receipt of the specified CBOA tax certificate. CBOA’s obligation is further subject to Bancorp 34 not terminating or adversely modifying the officer agreements without the affected officer’s written consent. The filing states that the OCC approved the bank-merger application on August 4, 2023; it does not state that all closing conditions have been satisfied.
event_status: Pending as of the August 10, 2023 filing; the merger agreement had been entered into, but the merger remained subject to shareholder approvals and other closing conditions. The OCC had approved the bank-merger application.
security_description: CBOA Financial, Inc. common stock, no par value per share. Excludes treasury shares, certain shares owned by either merger party, and shares held by shareholders who properly exercise dissenters’ rights. Outstanding CBOA restricted stock units receive separate treatment.
effective_date: Expected completion in the fourth quarter of 2023, subject to approvals and other closing conditions; no specific legal effective date or time is stated. The merger will become effective when the articles of merger have been filed with the Maryland and Arizona authorities, or at a later mutually agreed time specified in the articles.
available_options: No holder election; eligible CBOA common shares are converted at the fixed stock exchange ratio, with cash only in lieu of fractional shares. Properly exercised dissenters’ rights are a separate exception to that exchange.
