consideration_type: Stock and warrants: Picard common stockholders receive a pro rata portion of New Picard common stock and warrants, plus earnout warrants subject to a stock-price condition. Dissenting shares are excluded from this consideration.
stock_exchange_ratio: Each share of Picard Medical, Inc. common stock, including shares issued upon conversion of preferred stock and convertible notes but excluding dissenting shares, converts into the right to receive a pro rata portion of an aggregate 48,000,000 shares of New Picard common stock, subject to adjustment for Picard’s closing cash and indebtedness. The filing estimates an exchange ratio of approximately 1.468 as of 8/14/2023; fractional New Picard shares are rounded down.
shareholder_vote_date: Picard Supporting Stockholders approved the mergers and related matters by written consent on 4/24/2023. Altitude Acquisition Corp. stockholders are to vote at a special meeting on an unspecified date in 2023; its time and Eastern Time zone are stated, but the hour is unspecified.
closing_conditions: The mergers are subject to satisfaction or waiver of conditions including Altitude and Picard stockholder approval; absence of prohibiting laws, orders or governmental actions; required governmental approvals and expiration or termination of applicable HSR Act waiting periods; and each party’s applicable representations, warranties and covenant compliance. Altitude’s conditions also include no Picard Material Adverse Effect, release of specified liens, termination of Picard’s Investors’ Rights Agreement, execution of the lock-up and registration rights agreements, and a FIRPTA certificate. Picard’s conditions include effectiveness of the proposed certificate of incorporation, an executed registration rights agreement, Aggregate Parent Closing Cash of at least $38,000,000 subject to limitations in the Company Disclosure Letter, and conditional Nasdaq listing approval and applicable listing compliance. The filing’s summary additionally describes a requirement for at least $10,000,000 from the Closing Offering. The Minimum Cash Condition may be waived by Picard in its sole discretion. Picard stockholder approval was obtained on 4/24/2023; the other conditions are not stated to have been satisfied.
event_status: Pending under a business combination agreement dated 4/23/2023; Picard Supporting Stockholders approved the mergers and related matters by written consent on 4/24/2023.
security_description: Picard Medical, Inc. common stock, including shares issued before the First Merger upon conversion of Picard preferred stock and any outstanding convertible notes; dissenting shares are excluded from ordinary merger consideration.
effective_date: The First Merger is to become effective upon filing its certificate of merger with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by the parties and specified in that certificate. The Second Merger is to become effective upon filing its certificate of merger, or at a later agreed time specified in that certificate, as soon as practicable after and on the same day as the First Merger. No calendar date or clock time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; the applicable common shares automatically convert into the right to receive the specified consideration, subject to the dissenting-share exception.

consideration_type: Stock and limited liability company units: Pubco Class B Common Stock and New Company Units, plus applicable contingent Earnout Shares and Earnout Units. Company Financing Units also receive Additional Company Financing Unit Consideration. The Company intends to elect to deliver Pubco Class A Common Stock instead of corresponding Pubco Class B Common Stock and New Company Units for some Company Units to satisfy listing requirements.
cash_consideration: No cash payment or distribution is made for Company Units held in the Company’s treasury. No cash merger consideration per other Company Unit is stated; cash may be paid in lieu of fractional shares of Pubco Series A Preferred Stock.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each outstanding Falcon’s Beyond Global, LLC Company Unit other than a treasury unit or Company Financing Unit: Pubco Class B Common Stock and New Company Units, each in a number equal to the Acquisition Merger Exchange Number, plus the applicable portion of any Earnout Shares and Earnout Units. For each Company Financing Unit: the same Per Unit Consideration plus Pubco Class B Common Stock and New Company Units, each in a number equal to the Additional Consideration Number. The Acquisition Merger Exchange Number equals (48,587,077 plus the Phantom Private Placement Investment Share Number) divided by aggregate Company Units, including Company Financing Units, outstanding immediately before the Acquisition Merger Effective Time after giving effect to Company Financing. The Phantom Private Placement Investment Share Number equals Gross Company Financing Proceeds divided by $10.00. acquirer: Falcon’s Beyond Global, Inc. (Pubco), into which FAST Acquisition Corp. II merges
consideration_type: Stock and assumed warrants. Existing FAST II Class A Common Stock, other than shares converted from Class B Common Stock, receives Pubco Class A Common Stock and Pubco Series A Preferred Stock, plus Additional SPAC Share Consideration. FAST II Class A Common Stock converted from Class B Common Stock receives Pubco Class A Common Stock and applicable contingent Earnout Shares. Outstanding FAST II Warrants are assumed by Pubco. FAST II shares redeemed through separately exercised public-stockholder redemption rights are excluded from the stock exchange.
cash_consideration: No cash merger consideration per unredeemed FAST II share is stated. Public Shares for which redemption rights are properly exercised are redeemed separately for cash equal to their pro rata portion of the Trust Fund, calculated as of two business days before consummation of the first transactions contemplated by the Merger Agreement. No cash settlements are made for fractional Pubco Common Stock shares eliminated by rounding.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each outstanding FAST II Class A Common Stock share other than a share converted from FAST II Class B Common Stock: 0.5 Pubco Class A Common Stock shares plus 0.5 Pubco Series A Preferred Stock shares and 50% of the Additional SPAC Share Consideration. For each FAST II Class A Common Stock share converted from Class B Common Stock: one Pubco Class A Common Stock share and the applicable portion of any Earnout Shares, subject to stated Sponsor share forfeitures. No fractional Pubco Common Stock shares will be issued; fractional shares are rounded to the nearest whole share.
closing_conditions: Conditions, subject to applicable satisfaction or waiver, include expiration or termination of applicable HSR Act waiting periods; absence of an effective governmental order making the Business Combination illegal or prohibiting or enjoining it; completion of FAST II public-share redemptions under the agreement and proxy statement/prospectus; effectiveness of the registration statement without an effective SEC stop order or pending threatened proceedings; approval of the Business Combination Proposal by FAST II stockholders; the Company Requisite Approval by written consent of a majority of the Company’s managers and all Company members; and approval for listing of Pubco Class A Common Stock and Series A Preferred Stock on an Approved Exchange, subject only to official notice of issuance and the sufficient-round-lot-holder requirement. FAST II’s additional conditions include specified accuracy of Company, Pubco and Merger Sub representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, an officer’s certificate, no Company Material Adverse Effect, delivery of applicable ancillary agreements and good-standing certificates. The Company, Pubco and Merger Sub additionally require specified accuracy of FAST II representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, an officer’s certificate and delivery of applicable ancillary agreements. The Business Combination is not subject to a minimum cash condition.
event_status: Pending; the amended and restated merger agreement was further amended on June 25, 2023 and July 7, 2023. The filing describes the Business Combination as proposed, not completed.
security_description: FAST Acquisition Corp. II Class A Common Stock, distinguishing public shares from Class A shares converted from Class B Common Stock; outstanding FAST II Warrants are also assumed. FAST II treasury or subsidiary-held Common Stock is cancelled without consideration, and shares subject to exercised redemption rights are excluded from exchange.
effective_date: Conditional: 8:01 a.m., New York City time, on the date immediately following the Closing Date. No calendar date is stated.
available_options: FAST II public stockholders may separately elect cash redemption of Public Shares regardless of how, or whether, they vote on the Business Combination Proposal. Non-redeemed eligible shares receive the specified fixed Pubco stock consideration; no election among merger stock-consideration forms is stated. The Sponsor waived redemption rights for FAST II shares it holds.
election_deadline: For public-share cash redemption, holders must complete the stated redemption procedures at least two business days before the scheduled Special Meeting vote. The filing leaves the calendar date blank; this is a redemption deadline, not a deadline to elect among forms of merger consideration.

consideration_type: Stock; Borealis shareholders will receive New Oxus common shares, which will continue as New Borealis common shares after the subsequent amalgamation. The number of shares is subject to the closing net indebtedness adjustment.
stock_exchange_ratio: A variable number of New Oxus common shares per 1 Borealis Share, equal to the Aggregate Transaction Consideration divided by the aggregate number of Borealis Shares issued and outstanding immediately before the Borealis Amalgamation becomes effective. The Aggregate Transaction Consideration equals the Borealis Value divided by $10.00; the Borealis Value is $150,000,000 minus positive Company Closing Net Indebtedness or plus the absolute value of negative Company Closing Net Indebtedness. The New Oxus common shares will continue as New Borealis common shares.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted, waiver of closing conditions, including approval by Oxus and Borealis shareholders; approval of the Borealis arrangement resolution under the interim order and applicable law; a final court order approving the arrangement; required antitrust and foreign direct investment approvals or clearances, including Investment Canada Act approval, which the filing says has already been obtained; required Borealis third-party consents; no law or order preventing the transaction; Oxus having at least $5,000,001 in net tangible assets after redemptions; at least $30,000,000 in Closing Available Cash, with the minimum cash condition reduced by qualifying pre-closing financing proceeds; and SEC effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement. Oxus and Newco also require the specified accuracy of Borealis representations and warranties, material compliance with Borealis covenants, no Borealis Material Adverse Effect, required closing documents and agreements, delivery of PCAOB-audited financial statements, and Borealis Closing Indebtedness not exceeding $17,000,000. Borealis also requires the specified accuracy of Oxus and Newco representations and warranties, material compliance with their covenants, no Oxus Material Adverse Effect, required closing documents and agreements, and acceptance of the new shares for listing on Nasdaq or another agreed U.S. national securities exchange.
event_status: Pending; the business combination agreement was signed on February 23, 2023 and amended on August 11, 2023.
security_description: Borealis Shares: the issued and outstanding Class A, Class B, Class C and Class D common shares of Borealis Foods Inc., including shares issued upon the specified pre-amalgamation conversion of Borealis convertible instruments and exercise of Borealis options. New Investor Convertible Notes have separate post-amalgamation treatment.
effective_date: Proposed Borealis Amalgamation on the Closing Date, as part of the Arrangement; its step is deemed effective at a five-minute interval beginning at the Arrangement Effective Time. The Arrangement Effective Time is 5:01 p.m. Toronto time on the Arrangement Effective Date, or another time agreed to in writing before that date. No calendar date is stated.
available_options: No holder election; each Borealis Share will be exchanged for New Oxus common shares at the applicable exchange rate.

acquirer: Pono Capital Three, Inc. (through its wholly owned merger subsidiary, Pono Three Merger Acquisitions Corp.)
target: Robinson Aircraft Ltd. d/b/a Horizon Aircraft
consideration_type: Stock; eligible Horizon shareholders receive Pono Class A ordinary shares, subject to escrow withholding, a possible reduction for Incentive Shares, and a post-closing adjustment.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration is payable to exchanging Horizon shareholders; no cash is payable in lieu of fractional Pono Class A ordinary shares. Dissenting shareholders have a separate right to be paid the fair value of their Horizon shares.
stock_exchange_ratio: A variable number of Pono Class A ordinary shares per Horizon share: each eligible Horizon shareholder receives its pro rata portion of aggregate Exchange Consideration equal to (US$96,000,000 minus Closing Net Indebtedness) divided by the Redemption Price. The amount otherwise issuable is subject to a 3% escrow withholding, a possible reduction of up to US$8,000,000 divided by the Redemption Price for Incentive Shares, and a post-closing adjustment. Shares issued to each shareholder are rounded down to a whole share, without cash in lieu of a fraction.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver where permissible: requisite Pono and Horizon shareholder approvals; expiration or termination of applicable antitrust waiting periods; required governmental approvals and specified third-party consents; no law or order preventing the transaction; at least $5,000,001 in net tangible assets after redemptions and any equity-financing proceeds; appointment of the post-closing board; an effective Form F-4 registration statement with no stop order; Nasdaq listing approval for the exchange shares; and completion of Pono’s continuance to British Columbia. Horizon’s additional conditions include Pono and Merger Sub representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, no continuing uncured material adverse effect, at least $5,000,000 from the specified cash and financing sources after Pono transaction expenses, and specified closing deliveries, including executed registration rights and escrow agreements. Pono’s additional conditions include Horizon representations and warranties, material covenant compliance, no continuing uncured material adverse effect, and specified closing deliveries, including employment, non-competition, lock-up, registration rights and escrow agreements and evidence that outstanding Horizon convertible securities have been extinguished.
event_status: Announced and pending; the Business Combination Agreement was executed on 8/15/2023, and closing remains subject to conditions.
security_description: Horizon Company Shares: Class A Common Shares, Class B Common Shares and Class C Common Shares. The Class C shares are non-voting; dissenting shareholders and shares held by Pono or its wholly owned subsidiaries are excluded from the ordinary shareholder exchange.
effective_date: Not specified. The amalgamation is to become effective at the time stated in the Certificate of Amalgamation; it is contemplated to occur at closing, subject to the transaction conditions.
available_options: No holder election for ordinary merger consideration; eligible Horizon shareholders receive Pono Class A ordinary shares. Dissenting shareholders instead have a separate right to fair value under the dissent process.

acquirer: Capstone Dental PubCo, Inc., initially a wholly owned subsidiary of Keystone Dental Holdings, Inc.; its wholly owned U.S. merger subsidiary, Capstone Merger Sub Corp., will merge into Keystone Dental Holdings, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; each eligible share of Keystone common stock converts into the right to receive PubCo common stock.
stock_exchange_ratio: A variable number of shares of Capstone Dental PubCo, Inc. common stock per 1 share of Keystone Dental Holdings, Inc. common stock. The Keystone Exchange Ratio, rounded to four decimal places, equals Keystone Implied Share Value divided by Check-Cap Implied Share Value. Keystone Implied Share Value is $225,000,000 divided by the fully diluted Keystone Outstanding Share Number; Check-Cap Implied Share Value is Check-Cap Valuation divided by the fully diluted Check-Cap Outstanding Share Number. Check-Cap Valuation is $39,700,000 minus any Net Cash Shortfall Amount plus any Net Cash Excess Amount, using a $22,300,000 net cash target and the agreement’s $1,000,000 shortfall or excess thresholds. Consideration is subject to adjustment for a stock split or similar change before the U.S. merger effective time. Fractional PubCo shares are rounded to the nearest whole share, with 0.5 rounded up.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted written waiver: effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an outstanding stop order or related proceeding; no effective legal restraint or law making the transactions illegal; Check-Cap shareholder transaction approval and Keystone stockholder transaction approval; Nasdaq approval for listing PubCo common stock and the shares issued in the mergers; expiration or termination of any applicable antitrust waiting period; at least 50 days after filing the Israeli merger proposal, at least 30 days after Check-Cap shareholder approval, and issuance of the Israeli merger certificate; receipt of the ISA no-action letter and specified Israeli tax rulings or permitted interim rulings. Additional party-specific conditions include the other parties’ representations and warranties meeting contractual accuracy standards, material covenant compliance, no applicable material adverse effect, termination of specified investor agreements, required resignations and closing deliverables. Keystone’s additional conditions include documentation of any Check-Cap legacy transactions, termination of designated Check-Cap personnel, continued Nasdaq listing without a threatened or imposed trading suspension, Israeli court approval of the Check-Cap dividend, and the capital reduction tax ruling. Check-Cap’s additional conditions include the registration rights agreement, PubCo’s IIA undertaking, and evidence of the Keystone 2021 SPA amendment.
event_status: Pending; definitive business combination agreement entered into and transaction remains subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Keystone Dental Holdings, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the U.S. merger effective time, excluding Keystone dissenting shares and shares held in treasury or by a Keystone subsidiary. Keystone options and warrants have separately specified treatment.
effective_date: Conditional: on the closing date, concurrently with or immediately after the Israeli merger effective time, the U.S. merger becomes effective when its certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by the parties and specified in that certificate. No calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election for common-stock merger consideration.

consideration_type: Elective consideration: eligible Neurogene capital stockholders may receive Neoleukin common stock or pre-funded warrants to purchase Neoleukin common stock, subject to an automatic warrant election to prevent beneficial ownership above 9.99%.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration per share of Neurogene capital stock is stated. No cash will be paid for fractional shares eliminated by rounding.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each outstanding share of Neurogene capital stock, the stock option provides shares of Neoleukin common stock equal to the exchange ratio. Based on capitalization as of 7/17/2023, the ratio was estimated at approximately 1.7378 shares of Neoleukin common stock per 1 share of Neurogene capital stock, before the potential reverse stock splits. The final ratio is subject to adjustment based on Neoleukin’s closing net cash and aggregate proceeds of Neurogene’s pre-closing financing. Fractions are rounded to whole shares, with no cash paid for fractions eliminated by rounding.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver, where permitted, of: effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an outstanding stop order or proceeding seeking one, and compliance with applicable material state securities laws; absence of an effective court or governmental restraint or law making the merger or related transactions illegal; Neurogene approval by holders of a majority of outstanding common stock voting together on an as-converted basis and holders of 62% of outstanding preferred stock held by qualified holders; Neoleukin approval of Proposal No. 1 and either or both of Proposal Nos. 2 and 4, with the requisite vote described as a majority of votes properly cast; approval for Nasdaq listing of the shares issued in the merger, including shares underlying pre-funded warrants; the other party’s applicable representations and warranties meeting the specified accuracy standards, material compliance with covenants, and delivery of required documents; no applicable material adverse effect on either party; Neurogene’s subscription agreement remaining in force and Neurogene receiving, or receiving substantially simultaneously with closing, at least $75.0 million of gross pre-closing financing proceeds; and Neoleukin net cash, as finally determined under the merger agreement, of at least $60.0 million.
event_status: Pending as of the 8/18/2023 preliminary proxy statement/prospectus; the merger agreement had been entered into, but completion remained subject to conditions. Closing was anticipated in the fourth quarter of 2023.
security_description: Outstanding Neurogene capital stock, including Class A common stock, Class B common stock, preferred stock, and common stock issued in the Neurogene pre-closing financing. Shares canceled under the merger agreement and dissenting shares are excluded. Neurogene pre-funded warrants and stock options have separately described treatment.
effective_date: Not specified. The merger will become effective upon filing a certificate of merger with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by Neoleukin and Neurogene and specified in that certificate; the exact timing cannot be predicted.
available_options: Eligible Neurogene capital stockholders may elect either (1) Neoleukin common stock at the exchange ratio or (2) Neoleukin pre-funded warrants entitling them to purchase Neoleukin common stock at the exchange ratio. A holder is automatically treated as electing warrants to the extent needed to prevent beneficial ownership of more than 9.99% of outstanding Neoleukin common stock after the merger.
default_option: A Neurogene capital stockholder who makes no election is deemed to elect Neoleukin common stock, except to the extent the holder is automatically treated as electing pre-funded warrants to prevent beneficial ownership above 9.99%.

acquirer: Glencore AG
consideration_type: Cash
cash_consideration: US$2.11 in cash per PolyMet common share not already owned by Glencore or its affiliates, other than shares held by shareholders who validly exercise dissent rights. The Plan of Arrangement provides for a reduction in aggregate consideration if PolyMet makes a distribution to shareholders of record before the Effective Time.
stock_exchange_ratio: No stock consideration
closing_conditions: The arrangement is subject to: approval by at least two-thirds of votes cast by PolyMet shareholders voting as one class and by more than 50% of votes cast excluding Glencore-affiliated and other shares required to be excluded under MI 61-101; acceptable interim and final court orders; no law or proceeding prohibiting completion; required regulatory approvals on reasonably satisfactory terms; and the Arrangement Agreement remaining in effect. Glencore must materially comply with its covenants, its representations and warranties must satisfy the stated material-adverse-effect standard, and it must deposit sufficient consideration with the depositary. PolyMet must materially comply with its covenants; its specified organizational, subsidiary, authority and capitalization representations must be true in all respects and its other representations must satisfy the stated Material Adverse Effect standard; shareholders representing no more than 7.5% of outstanding shares may exercise dissent rights; no Material Adverse Effect may have occurred since the agreement date; specified proceedings must not be pending or threatened in writing; and PolyMet must provide the specified U.S. real-property-interest certificate and complete specified filings and contractual arrangements. Conditions may be waived by the party or parties for whose benefit they exist. Completion is not subject to a financing condition.
event_status: Pending; the Arrangement Agreement was executed and announced, but shareholder and court approvals and other closing conditions remained.
security_description: Common shares, without par value, of PolyMet Mining Corp. that are not owned by Glencore or its affiliates (Minority Shares). Shares for which dissent rights are validly exercised have separate fair-value treatment.
effective_date: Not fixed. The Effective Date is to be designated in writing by Glencore and PolyMet after satisfaction or waiver of the applicable conditions; absent agreement, it is three Business Days after satisfaction or waiver. The Effective Time is 12:01 a.m. Vancouver time on that date unless they agree otherwise in writing.
available_options: No holder election among forms of merger consideration. Minority shareholders other than validly dissenting shareholders receive cash; eligible registered shareholders may separately exercise dissent rights and seek fair value.
default_option: For a registered shareholder who does not elect Canadian-dollar payment before the Effective Date, the cash consideration is paid in U.S. dollars.
election_deadline: A registered shareholder's election to receive the cash payment in Canadian dollars must be made before the Effective Date; this is a currency election, not an election among forms of merger consideration.

acquirer: SEP Acquisition Corp. (SEPA), through its wholly owned merger subsidiary, SEP Acquisition Holdings Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; SANUWAVE common stock converts into SEPA Class A common stock at the Conversion Ratio. Outstanding SANUWAVE options, warrants and convertible notes have separate treatment within the aggregate merger consideration.
stock_exchange_ratio: A number of shares of SEP Acquisition Corp. Class A common stock equal to the Conversion Ratio per 1 share of SANUWAVE Health, Inc. common stock. The Conversion Ratio is rounded to four decimal places and equals (7,793,000 plus the Aggregate Exercise Price divided by 10) divided by Company Fully Diluted Shares, as defined in the merger agreement. It is subject to equitable adjustment for specified changes in outstanding shares before the Effective Time. Fractional shares otherwise issuable to a holder are aggregated and rounded up to the nearest whole share.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver where permissible: requisite SEPA and SANUWAVE stockholder approvals; specified third-party consents; no law or order prohibiting the transactions; filing of SEPA charter amendments; appointment of the post-closing SEPA board; an effective Form S-4 registration statement with no stop order; Nasdaq approval for listing SEPA Class A common stock after closing; agreement by holders of at least 80% of specified SANUWAVE convertible notes, measured by convertible shares, and at least 80% of SANUWAVE warrants, measured by underlying shares, to convert them into SANUWAVE common stock immediately before the Effective Time. SANUWAVE's additional conditions include SEPA's and Merger Sub's representations and warranties meeting the stated material-adverse-effect standard, SEPA's material covenant compliance, no SEPA material adverse effect, delivery of a satisfactory fairness opinion, at least $12,000,000 at closing from non-redeemed SEPA shares and PIPE proceeds on mutually acceptable terms, and specified closing documents including a registration rights agreement and amendments to the letter and warrant agreements. SEPA's and Merger Sub's additional conditions include SANUWAVE's representations and warranties meeting the stated material-adverse-effect standard, SANUWAVE's material covenant compliance, no material adverse effect on the SANUWAVE target companies, effective SANUWAVE lock-up agreements, and specified closing deliveries including an underwriter liability waiver.
event_status: Announced; merger agreement executed on August 23, 2023, with closing subject to conditions.

effective_date: Upon filing the Articles of Merger with the Nevada Secretary of State, or at a later time specified in those articles; no calendar date or time is stated.
available_options: No holder election for the stated common-stock consideration.

consideration_type: Stock; SANUWAVE common stock converts into SEPA Class A common stock at the Conversion Ratio, subject to the stated treatment of treasury shares and dissenting shares.
stock_exchange_ratio: A number of shares of SEP Acquisition Corp. Class A common stock equal to the Conversion Ratio per 1 share of SANUWAVE Health, Inc. common stock. Fractional SEPA Class A shares are not issued; a holder's aggregate entitlement is rounded up to the nearest whole share.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or written waiver where permissible: requisite SEPA and SANUWAVE stockholder approvals; specified third-party consents; no effective law or order preventing the transactions; filing of SEPA charter amendments; appointment of the post-closing SEPA board; an effective Form S-4 registration statement with no stop order; Nasdaq listing approval for SEPA Class A common stock; agreement by holders of at least 80% of the specified SANUWAVE convertible notes and at least 80% of the specified SANUWAVE warrants, measured by underlying shares, to convert into SANUWAVE common stock immediately before the Effective Time. SANUWAVE's additional conditions include SEPA's representations and warranties meeting the agreement's standard, material performance of its obligations and covenants, no SEPA Material Adverse Effect, delivery of the specified fairness opinion, at least $12,000,000 upon Closing from non-redeemed SEPA Class A shares and PIPE proceeds on mutually acceptable terms, and specified agreements, amendments and closing deliveries. SEPA's additional conditions include SANUWAVE's representations and warranties meeting the agreement's standard, material performance of its obligations and covenants, no Material Adverse Effect on the Target Companies taken as a whole, Company Lock-Up Agreements remaining in force, and specified closing deliveries.

default_option: Under the attached Scheme, an eligible shareholder with an address in Australia or its external territories, New Zealand or Papua New Guinea who does not make a valid Share Election receives New Newmont CDIs. target: Ambrx Biopharma Inc., a Cayman Islands exempted company, which will survive the merger as a direct wholly owned subsidiary of NewCo.
consideration_type: Stock, with cash paid instead of fractional shares. The stated conversion excludes ordinary shares held by shareholders who properly exercise dissenters’ rights.
cash_consideration: Cash only in lieu of fractional shares of NewCo common stock; no fixed cash amount per Ambrx ordinary share or ADS is stated. event_status: Pending; the filing describes a proposed merger subject to shareholder approval and other closing conditions.
security_description: Ambrx Biopharma Inc. ordinary shares, par value $0.0001 per share, including ordinary shares underlying its outstanding American Depositary Shares (ADSs). Each ADS represents seven Ambrx ordinary shares.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Ambrx ordinary shares convert at the stated fixed stock ratio, and ADS holders receive the right to one NewCo common share per ADS, subject to the dissenting-share exception and cash in lieu of fractional shares.

acquirer: Stratasys Ltd. (parent); its wholly owned subsidiary Tetris Sub Inc. will merge with and into Desktop Metal, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; eligible Desktop Metal Class A common stock is converted into the right to receive Stratasys ordinary shares. Cash is payable only in lieu of fractional Stratasys shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per share is specified. A holder otherwise entitled to a fractional Stratasys ordinary share receives cash in U.S. dollars, rounded to the nearest cent and without interest, equal to the fraction multiplied by the closing price of a Stratasys ordinary share on the last trading day before the Merger becomes effective.
stock_exchange_ratio: Fixed ratio of 0.123 Stratasys ordinary shares, par value NIS 0.01 per share, per 1 share of Desktop Metal Class A common stock, par value $0.0001 per share. The ratio will not be adjusted for changes in either company's share price before completion. No fractional Stratasys ordinary shares will be issued; holders receive cash in lieu of fractions.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled for 9/28/2023: Stratasys Ltd. shareholders vote at 3:00 p.m. Israel time / 8:00 a.m. Eastern time on the Stratasys Merger-related proposal; Desktop Metal, Inc. stockholders vote at 9:00 a.m. Eastern time on adoption of the Merger Agreement.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or waiver on or before closing: approval of the Stratasys Merger-related proposal and the Desktop Metal Merger Agreement proposal; Nasdaq authorization to list the Stratasys shares issued in the Merger; expiration or termination of the HSR Act waiting period and any agreement with the DOJ or FTC not to consummate; CFIUS approval and other required regulatory approvals or applicable waiting-period expirations; effectiveness of the Form F-4 registration statement without a stop order or proceedings seeking one; and absence of legal restraints prohibiting or preventing the Merger. Each party's obligation is also subject to specified accuracy standards for the other party's representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, and absence of a continuing material adverse effect. Stratasys and Merger Sub additionally require specified Desktop Metal agreements to be amended, modified or terminated. German foreign direct investment clearance was granted unconditionally on 7/27/2023; the DOJ issued second requests on 8/18/2023, extending the HSR waiting period.
event_status: Pending as of the 8/25/2023 joint proxy statement/prospectus; the Merger Agreement was signed on 5/25/2023, and completion remained subject to approvals and other conditions.
security_description: Desktop Metal, Inc. effective_date: Not specified as a calendar date. available_options: No holder election; eligible shares receive the fixed stock consideration, with cash only in lieu of fractional shares.

Additional party-specific conditions include material performance of obligations; accuracy of representations and warranties subject to specified materiality thresholds; no applicable material adverse effect since the agreement date; and delivery of executive-officer certificates. ExxonMobil's and EMPF Corporation's obligations additionally require the specified legal-restraint and HSR conditions to be satisfied without a Burdensome Condition. acquirer: AgeX Therapeutics, Inc.; its wholly owned subsidiary, Canaria Transaction Corporation, will merge into Serina Therapeutics, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock; each eligible share of Serina capital stock, after conversion of Serina preferred stock into common stock, converts solely into the right to receive AgeX common stock. Treasury or affiliated shares are canceled without consideration, and properly perfected appraisal shares are excluded.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration is stated. Fractional AgeX shares are rounded to one whole share if the holder's aggregate fractional entitlement is at least 0.50, and to no share if it is less than 0.50; no cash-in-lieu payment is specified.
stock_exchange_ratio: A variable number of shares of AgeX common stock per 1 eligible share of Serina capital stock, after conversion of Serina preferred stock into Serina common stock, equal to the Exchange Ratio: Company Merger Shares divided by Company Outstanding Shares. Company Merger Shares equal 75.00% of Post-Closing Parent Shares, rounded to the nearest whole share; Post-Closing Parent Shares equal Parent Outstanding Shares divided by 1.00 minus 75.00%. The ratio is subject to equitable adjustment for specified share changes. Fractional AgeX shares are rounded to one whole share if the holder's aggregate fractional entitlement is at least 0.50, and to no share if it is less than 0.50. If the applicable AgeX closing-price condition is not met, AgeX may offer to adjust the ratio as specified in the agreement.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted written waiver of applicable conditions: no effective legal restraint or law making the transactions illegal; required AgeX and Serina stockholder approvals; continuous NYSE listing of existing AgeX common stock and approval for listing of shares issued in the transaction; effectiveness of the registration statement without an applicable stop order or proceeding; the Side Letter and conversion of Juvenescence's AgeX preferred stock before the reverse split; completion of a reverse split resulting in approximately 2,500,000 AgeX common shares immediately before effectiveness; accuracy of representations and warranties and material compliance with covenants; no continuing material adverse effect for either company; specified Serina investor agreements terminated, lock-up agreements effective, Serina stockholder written consents effective, no more than 5% of Serina capital stock exercising appraisal rights, delivery of the specified FIRPTA certificate, and conversion elections for Serina notes other than notes held by AgeX; specified AgeX contracts terminated, assigned or fully performed with obligations satisfied, waived or discharged, and AgeX lock-up agreements effective; AgeX's applicable closing price at least $12.00 per share, Juvenescence holding at least 1,133,308 Post-Merger Warrants, and AgeX holding at least $500,000 of immediately spendable non-restricted cash net of payables and other liabilities immediately before closing. Required closing documents must also be delivered.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was entered into on 8/29/2023, and completion remained subject to stockholder approval and closing conditions.

available_options: No holder election; eligible Serina capital stock converts solely into the right to receive AgeX common stock, subject to the stated exclusions and appraisal rights.
